In a couple of weeks, she finds out that she is pregnant. The girl cannot admit to anyone what happened and finds herself all alone in front of the most difficult choice. Tony's classmate Mitya suddenly becomes the only one who lends a shoulder. Under the yoke of condemnation from parents and the public, the heroine will have to go through a difficult path.
tvmaze:86243.title: 16 лет и 9 месяцев

tvmaze:86410.overview: Wake up to reliable reporting that delivers the essential facts you need to start your day informed, along with expert commentary and thoughtful analysis. Get an early look at the top stories shaping national and global conversations. Whether it's politics, business, culture, or breaking news, you'll be prepared for whatever the day brings.
tvmaze:86410.title: Wake Up America Early

tvmaze:86450.overview: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza follows a very scared man as he navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes.
tvmaze:86450.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza

tvmaze:86558.overview: The improvised stand-up show where the audience is the material.
tvmaze:86558.title: Crowd Control

tvmaze:86587.overview: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.
tvmaze:86587.title: War

tvmaze:8660.overview: Four Corners is Australia's premier television current affairs program. It has been part of the national story since August 1961, exposing scandals, triggering inquiries, firing debate, confronting taboos and interpreting fads, trends and sub-cultures. Its consistently high standards of journalism and film-making have earned international recognition and an array of Walkleys, Logies and other national awards.
tvmaze:8660.title: Four Corners

tvmaze:8661.overview: The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network -- ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference -- is SEC Now, broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams.
tvmaze:8661.title: SEC Now

tvmaze:86618.overview: Sin City Rehab will document Alison, best known for her Emmy®-nominated series Windy City Rehab, taking the biggest gamble of her career as she expands her successful design business out West. Alison will bet on herself for lofty rewards, diving headfirst into multi-million-dollar client projects and risky flips all while building a team and reputation from the ground up in a flashy new market.
tvmaze:86618.title: Sin City Rehab

tvmaze:8662.overview: "College GameDay" has been a popular college football pregame show on ESPN since 1987 and has been taking the show to college campuses across the country since 1993. Now the same concept is being used on SEC Nation a flagship show on ESPN-owned SEC Network. Rather than discussing games from all conferences, the show features games involving teams of the titular conference and originates at a location in SEC country. ``SEC Nation'' is hosted by Joe Tessitore, who is joined by radio host Paul Finebaum, former players Greg McElroy and Marcus Spears, and reporter Kaylee Hartung to preview the day's games.
tvmaze:8662.title: SEC Nation

tvmaze:86691.overview: American Pulse is an hour showcasing reporting from the vast network of CNN affiliates across the country.
tvmaze:86691.title: American Pulse

tvmaze:86764.overview: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.
tvmaze:86764.title: Crossroad Springs

tvmaze:86784.overview: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) "committed suicide", her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her "nice sisters" Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film "The Rose" as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate.
tvmaze:86784.title: War of Thorns

tvmaze:86823.overview: Mark is a high school student at an elite school, whose carefree life ends one day: his beloved girlfriend Ailin becomes distant with zero explanation. At the same time, Mark begins to see strange targeted messages on his social media feed, which seem to be messages from the future as they describe events that begin to happen in real life. When he receives a "target" predicting that a life-threatening fire will break out at the school, he realizes he must act. Now, Mark needs not only to figure out his relationship with Ailin, but also to prevent a catastrophe by finding the arsonist. Having managed to convince his peers that the danger is real, they set out to prevent a catastrophe.
tvmaze:86823.title: Target

tvmaze:86834.overview: The biggest names in sport and entertainment join host Kelly Somers for bold, in-depth conversations about the nation's favourite sport.
tvmaze:86834.title: The Football Interview

tvmaze:86861.overview: "The fort. Return of the Legend" is an adventure show, in each episode of which the star characters sail to the fort of Emperor Alexander the Great, where they will be tested at altitude, in the water, surrounded by wild insects and animals, in mysterious cells and towers in the company of mysterious inhabitants of the ancient fortress. During the game, the team needs to collect all five parts of the key and hints in order to get the treasures of Peter the Great, according to legend, hidden in Fort Kronshlot.
tvmaze:86861.title: Форт. Возвращение легенды

tvmaze:86879.overview: Knights of Guinevere is a psychological thriller that welcomes you to a planet-wide theme park in the clouds!… And the shadows below, where a broken Princess Android is two dreamers' tickets to better lives, or the end of them.
tvmaze:86879.title: Knights of Guinevere

tvmaze:86943.overview: Ten Norwegians fight against both the wild jungle and their own impulses when wild temptations distract them from their goal - a prize pool of 2.5 million kroner.
tvmaze:86943.title: Ville fristelser

tvmaze:86963.overview: Alice Bell is a former nurse, and also the lover, and accomplice, of a notorious anaesthetist serial killer. She is presently living in Britain under a new identity. When, online, Fran Da Silva is accused of being Alice Bell, her happy family life implodes in a wave of mob hate. Then she discovers she's not the only woman to suffer this fate. Fran and the other accused women band together to fight back and clear their names. But as they battle to prove their innocence, what if one of the group is lying - and is the real Alice Bell…?
tvmaze:86963.title: Hunting Alice Bell

tvmaze:87011.overview: Award-winning investigations - revealing secrets, rooting out injustice, and exposing crime, corruption, and abuse. The biggest stories from BBC correspondents all over the world.
tvmaze:87011.title: Global Eye

tvmaze:87104.overview: Detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions.
tvmaze:87104.title: Killer Investigations

tvmaze:87106.overview: Australia, this is Big Brother. Standby for an important announcement.The show that made TV history is coming home. Big Brother is back on 10, back at Dreamworld, and back on your screens this November.Hosted by Mel Tracina, the reboot will feature everything you loved in the noughties: live nominations, live evictions, and all the action live from Dreamworld.Fans don't just want to watch the OG show, they want to be in it. With 20,000 housemate applications already received, Australia has never been readier for a return of the original and the best.Big Brother is always watching, and this November, so can you.
tvmaze:87106.title: Big Brother

tvmaze:87107.overview: Star Trek: Scouts follows three 8-year-old friends, JR, Sprocket and Roo, as they train to become future Starfleet Explorers by going on epic, out-of-this-world missions that push them to "discover, grow and boldly go!"
tvmaze:87107.title: Star Trek: Scouts

tvmaze:87146.overview: When it comes to chasing criminals, two wheels are better than four. In this brand new high-octane series, nowhere is off limits for the country's highly trained police bikers. They are the UK's fastest responders, at the ready to race at top speed to save lives and catch suspects on the run.
tvmaze:87146.title: Traffic Cops: Elite Squad One

tvmaze:87181.overview: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.
tvmaze:87181.title: Искусство падения

tvmaze:87256.overview: Ed Gamble is joined by the latest murdered and banished players to unpack all the drama from The Celebrity Traitors.
tvmaze:87256.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked

tvmaze:87357.overview: In Hawaii, the word "ohana" means family and for this bold, vibrant and tight-knit group of friends, they love and argue just like family. These young Hawaiian locals are stepping out of their parents' expectations and carving their own paths while still embracing their culture. As they navigate love, face heartbreak and test friendship loyalties, this group proves life on the island has just as much shade as there is sun.
tvmaze:87357.title: O'ahu Shores

tvmaze:87454.overview: Jimmy Carr is joined by GK Barry & Jamali Maddix to preside over a parade of potential A******s. From petty behaviour to jaw-dropping admissions, the panel decide whether they're a grade A a******.
tvmaze:87454.title: Jimmy Carr's Am I the A******?

tvmaze:87455.overview: I Kill The Bear is a comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why – after 100 years – they've decided to make this film their last.
tvmaze:87455.title: I Kill The Bear

tvmaze:87480.overview: After a dance-team initiation goes wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.
tvmaze:87480.title: The Body

tvmaze:875.overview: Topical debate in which guests from the worlds of politics and the media answer questions posed by members of the public.
tvmaze:875.title: Question Time

tvmaze:87542.overview: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas. And because the holidays are a time for cooking with the ones you love, chefs will be invited to pair up in teams of two to compete for glory and goodwill. In every battle, teams will serve up a savory and a sweet dish based on the spin of the Randomizer. The chef teams will need to be in sync and on their game to earn the title, the belt, a $100,000 cash prize furnished by Carnival Cruise Lines and their split of an additional $50,000 prize to give to a cause close to their hearts.
tvmaze:87542.title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas

tvmaze:87566.overview: HARLAN COBEN'S FINAL TWIST brings the world's best-selling mystery author into the true-crime television genre. Known for his twisting narratives, intricate plots, and misdirects, Harlan has sold over 100 million books globally and seen his work adapted by Netflix. In each one-hour episode, Harlan guides viewers through gripping tales of murder, high-profile crimes and life-altering surprises, each meticulously unraveled to reveal hidden truths, deceptions and lies.
tvmaze:87566.title: Harlan Coben's Final Twist

tvmaze:8760.overview: Special Branch is a British television series made by Thames Television for ITV and shown between 1969 and 1974.Special Branch was a police drama series, centred on members of the Special Branch anti-espionage and anti-terrorist department of the London Metropolitan Police.
tvmaze:8760.title: Special Branch

tvmaze:87630.overview: The show "Traitors" is an adaptation of the world hit The Traitors. The Ukrainian reality show features 22 participants competing for half a million hryvnias. Among them are "loyal" and "traitors". The task of the "loyal" is to expose the traitors, and the traitors - to reach the final. The action takes place in the Schönborn castle.
tvmaze:87630.title: Зрадники

tvmaze:87677.overview: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.
tvmaze:87677.title: The Great Long March

tvmaze:87821.overview: The brutal Russian cop Vasya lives by his own concepts and does not recognize technology. However, fate brings him together with the artificial intelligence svt 1,9, or simply Sveta. Vasya tries to get rid of the imposed "partner", but eventually realizes that Sveta not only helps him solve crimes, but also gives him a chance to figure out his own life. An unusual couple investigates new cases, encountering curiosities, conflicts and unexpected discoveries.
tvmaze:87821.title: Нейровася

tvmaze:87855.overview: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.
tvmaze:87855.title: The Story Is with Elex Michaelson

tvmaze:88042.overview: Marry me? Just six months and we'll be divorced. Inspector Thiartha's mother gives him an ultimatum. To counteract his bad luck, he'll have to marry someone born Monday, the thirteenth of October. As if that weren't hard enough, their first and last names must contain the Thai consonant ro ruea. Turns out that his junior, Police Senior Sergeant Major Mangkorn, was born on exactly that day, name as prescribed, perfect to the last item.
tvmaze:88042.title: Police in Love

tvmaze:88065.overview: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.
tvmaze:88065.title: My Chef in Crime

tvmaze:88082.overview: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.
tvmaze:88082.title: Where the Mask Ends

tvmaze:88089.overview: University student Wan has a fanboy hobby, following and photographing rising star Nine. When Wan gets a casting opportunity for a support role in a Y series his idol will be starring in, he meets Third, a sharp-tongued leading man and Nine's ship partner. The two clash immediately, but when Wan passes his audition, the two are forced to work together. Despite their dislike for one another, after getting to know Third, Wan starts to look at his rival in a different light. He doesn't know what's wrong with him, but he finds himself avoiding the cocky leading man's gaze more and more often. Beyond that, Wan comes to learn that behind the curtain, the industry that looked so splendid isn't all as he'd thought. Even Nine, his own idol, is hiding something shady.
tvmaze:88089.title: Mr. Fanboy

tvmaze:8833.overview: This Week  is hosted by former Clinton White House staffer and current co-anchor of ABC's weekday morning news show "Good Morning America", George Stephanopoulos offers a look at current events with a focus on the politics of the day. Each week's show includes interviews with top newsmakers (including some of the nation's top political leaders) as well as a roundtable discussion, usually featuring journalists from ABC and other news organizations, of the week's happenings. Since 2008, the program has broadcast from a studio at the Newseum in Washington, D.C.
tvmaze:8833.title: This Week

tvmaze:8834.overview: Face the Nation is a news interview program which airs every Sunday morning, live from the CBS studio in Washington D.C. It is dedicated to interviewing newsmakers on the latest issues. Guests include government leaders, politicians, and international figures in the news. CBS News… More correspondents engage the guests in a lively roundtable discussion focusing on current topics. The show started on November 7th, 1954, and was originally broadcast on both CBS Television and Radio Networks. After close to two decades, the program was taken off CBS radio.
tvmaze:8834.title: Face the Nation

tvmaze:8835.overview: For almost as long as there has been television, there's been Meet the Press. The hourlong Sunday morning public affairs program has featured interviews with countless U.S. and world leaders, and has reviewed, analyzed and discussed the news of the week -- all while looking toward the week ahead.
tvmaze:8835.title: Meet the Press

tvmaze:88484.overview: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook Nora embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey as she explores contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's remarkable legacy.Nora's family ran Lum's, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York, and the very first in a now thriving Chinatown. But despite growing up in the family business, she can't cook. At all. She could ruin an instant ramen.
tvmaze:88484.title: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook

tvmaze:88520.overview: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!
tvmaze:88520.title: The Palace Gambit

tvmaze:88572.overview: Once betrayed and killed at the peak of his power, Ye Yunfei is reborn into his younger self—the moment his martial veins were first destroyed. With all the memories of his past life, he seizes this second chance to protect his loved ones, outmaneuver rival clans and sects, and rebuild his strength.
tvmaze:88572.title: Jiu Yang Wushen

tvmaze:88583.title: High & Low Born to be High

tvmaze:88589.overview: Perfect school tennis player Sun and indie, arts-track boy Bay have feuding fathers. Their families own competing dim sum restaurants on Krong Thong Road: Sun's family's old, traditional shop Saming Phon Fai, and Bay's family's Merlion, a new spot famous for its shumai. When Bay enters a tennis tryout to annoy Sun and Sun loses due to an injury, the principal orders a rematch. In turn, their fathers Chun and Bee strike a deal: whichever family loses must close their dim sum business for good. When the day of the match arrives and circumstances push them to take up representing the school as a doubles pair, the two keep it a secret from their fathers. As they train at a resort outside the city and begin to open up to each other, Bay and Sun make their own wager: if they win the men's doubles championship, their fathers must allow them to date; if they lose, however, they'll never see each other again.
tvmaze:88589.title: Match Point

tvmaze:88596.overview: In 1956, "Hong Sen", known as Hong Sen Kai Yod, the leader of the Nine Yod gang in Thonburi, and "Seng", aka Seng Kluang, the leader of the gang in the dusty district of Phra Nakhon, started a battle from the unsolved rage of the past. But in the midst of the two gangs that are ready to fight every time, love is formed in unexpected ways.
tvmaze:88596.title: Lovers & Gangsters

tvmaze:88739.overview: Two-part documentary exploring one of the strangest cases in modern British history In May 2008.
tvmaze:88739.title: Twisted Sisters: Madness & Manslaughter

tvmaze:88879.overview: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.
tvmaze:88879.title: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle

tvmaze:88889.overview: This is the story of the headstrong girl Zheng Yu and the lonely boy Chen Yan Zhou. Burdened by her family's poverty, Zheng Yu must take on heavy responsibilities, while Chen Yan Zhou withdraws into himself after the death of his older brother. From school rivals, they gradually become a light in each other's lives, facing life's storms together.
tvmaze:88889.title: Sunshine Through The Rain

tvmaze:89075.overview: Pagans follows a man who becomes the sole caretaker of his two children after the tragic loss of his wife. While his son is typical, his daughter, Alice, is anything but. What starts as a strained father-daughter relationship soon evolves into something far more sinister. Equal parts emotional, horrifying and humorous, Pagans is a show that unearths all our darkest thoughts about family.
tvmaze:89075.title: Pagans

tvmaze:89155.overview: After several years, Adrián and Mariana meet again at La Encantada, and just when they think their lives are settled, they realise they've never stopped loving each other. They must fight against those who seek to separate them.
tvmaze:89155.title: Sin pecado concebido

tvmaze:89192.overview: The F Ward is about brilliant, flawed interns whose careers are on life support. Sent to the under-funded Pines Hospital in Sydney for a final chance, they must overcome their insecurities, their past and their own expectations, in a hot house environment where the stakes are life and death.
tvmaze:89192.title: The F Ward

tvmaze:89844.overview: Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.
tvmaze:89844.title: Blue Skies

tvmaze:89896.overview: The prequel to the award-winning gangster drama ‘4 Blocks' tells the story of the Hamadys in 1990s Berlin: having fled Lebanon and only accepted as tolerated refugees in Germany, they struggle to gain a foothold in their new home. Who are they, how did the family become the most influential clan in the city, and how did Ali eventually become Toni?
tvmaze:89896.title: 4 Blocks Zero

tvmaze:89972.overview: The original work is the Korean-Japanese co-produced comic "Blue Road." The original story follows Korean detective Kang Cheong-do and Japanese detective Ino Se as they investigate bizarre murders that occurred in both Korea and Japan.
tvmaze:89972.title: Road

tvmaze:89983.overview: WWE Lucha Libre AAA highlights their partnership, blending WWE's global reach with AAA's rich Mexican tradition, focusing on shared talent like Rey Mysterio and Dominik Mysterio in explosive crossover events like Worlds Collide and TripleMania, showcasing vibrant lucha libre action for new audiences worldwide.
tvmaze:89983.title: WWE Lucha Libre AAA

tvmaze:90018.overview: Foul Play with Anthony Davis pairs elite athletes with elaborate pranks, giving them one chance to pull off their mischievous plans or foul out trying.
tvmaze:90018.title: Foul Play with Anthony Davis

tvmaze:90035.overview: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.
tvmaze:90035.title: The Remarried Empress

tvmaze:90062.overview: Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit. A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace, but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow — is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures. A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea, steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes, the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall… These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight. You can't help but smile and think, "So true!" A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.
tvmaze:90062.title: mofusand animation

tvmaze:90104.overview: Illegal salmon fishing, drug dealing, and deadly rivalries: crime is on the rise in the German-Czech border region, which is why a new team from the WaPo (water police) is manning the outpost on the Elbe.
tvmaze:90104.title: WaPo Elbe

tvmaze:90145.overview: Soul is a skilled architect. Xinxin is a successful Feng Shui master. When these two women with polar opposite personalities are hired to build a house together for its homeowners, a battle between them ensues. But will there be space for love to bloom?
tvmaze:90145.title: Built in Love

tvmaze:90157.overview: Katie Pavlich Tonight offers a conservative take on the day's events while welcoming all viewpoints. The goal: cutting through left-right bias in pursuit of plain facts and honest analysis.
tvmaze:90157.title: Katie Pavlich Tonight

tvmaze:90158.overview: A fresh, fast-paced, and often unexpected take on the day's headlines, diving into the biggest stories through the lens of an expert in legal affairs.
tvmaze:90158.title: Jesse Weber Live

tvmaze:90249.overview: Set in Gyeongseong during the Japanese colonial period, the drama follows Ga Gyeong, the city's most talented pickpocket, who strikes a dangerous deal with the independence army and goes undercover at the Japanese Government-General of Joseon. Disguised as an employee, she is tasked with acting as a "fake spy" for just 100 days, but her mission slowly turns her into a real informant caught between survival, loyalty, and conviction.
tvmaze:90249.title: 100 Days of Deception

tvmaze:90251.overview: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.
tvmaze:90251.title: The Ramparts of Ice

tvmaze:90279.overview: Ed Henry offers his common-sense take on the news.
tvmaze:90279.title: Ed Henry the Big Take

tvmaze:90392.overview: "Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.
tvmaze:90392.title: Седьмой игрок

tvmaze:90425.overview: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.
tvmaze:90425.title: Bass X Machina

tvmaze:90508.overview: Deep beneath the streets of London sit thousands of highly classified and previously top-secret government files which disclose the details of extensive military, spy agency and police investigations into the paranormal.With hundreds of hours dedicated to examining these formerly off-limits documents from the National Archives, investigative journalist Tim Tate reveals just how far authorities on both sides of the Atlantic were willing to go to venture into the unknown.Combining his findings with expert insight from Dr David Clarke, Britain's X-Files fact-checks out-of-this-world phenomena with cases including the legend of the Flying Dutchman, Harry Grindell Matthews and his Death Ray, the Beast of Bodmin, Uri Geller, the Comet plane catastrophes, premonitions on the Aberfan disaster and more.
tvmaze:90508.title: Britain's X Files

tvmaze:90580.overview: Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt. Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.
tvmaze:90580.title: История его служанки

tvmaze:90632.overview: When a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy as a family of law enforcement agents become the target of a mysterious assassin. Bridging personal differences and crossing professional boundaries, the Hollingsworth family must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice... even if it means betraying their sworn code.
tvmaze:90632.title: Line of Fire

tvmaze:9065.overview: With honesty and rigor, Rachel Maddow uniquely connects dots to advance stories on her show The Rachel Maddow Show. By exposing the layers of complex issues, she reveals their significance to viewers. In her irreverent style, Maddow transcends the narrative and provides unique perspective.
tvmaze:9065.title: The Rachel Maddow Show

tvmaze:90655.overview: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.
tvmaze:90655.title: Treasure Island

tvmaze:9068.overview: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.
tvmaze:9068.title: The Five

tvmaze:9069.overview: Special Report with Bret Baier (formerly Special Report with Brit Hume) is an American television news and political commentary program appearing on Fox News Channel, currently hosted by Bret Baier. It airs live each Monday through Friday at 6:00 PM ET. The show focuses on both reporting and analysis of the day's events, with a primary focus on national political news. The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.
tvmaze:9069.title: Special Report

tvmaze:90692.overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.
tvmaze:90692.title: My Royal Nemesis

tvmaze:9070.overview: Anderson Cooper 360° (commonly shortened to either AC-360 or 360) is a television news show on CNN, hosted by the American journalist Anderson Cooper. The program covers a number of news stories of the day, usually through live or taped reports from the network's correspondents. The coverage can also include analysis from experts on the issues, commonly featured in or after the taped reports.
tvmaze:9070.title: Anderson Cooper 360°

tvmaze:9072.overview: Erin Burnett OutFront is an hour-long television news program hosted by Erin Burnett on CNN. The show premiered on October 3, 2011 in the 7PM and 11PM time slot to replace John King, USA. CNN said in 2011 they hoped Burnett's expected popularity would provide an "attractive" opening to an evening of "talk shows and news analysis". Erin Burnett, OutFront is broadcast live from CNN's Time Warner Center studios in New York City or on location from the site of a breaking news event, airing from 7:00 pm ET to 8:00 pm ET and also airs via tape-delay on CNN Philippines every Tuesday-Friday at 5:00 pm local time since March 17, 2015. The program covers a number of news stories of the day in a Count-up format, starting at #1 – most important and making it to #7 by the end of the hour. Burnett's program features taped packages from CNN Correspondents along with analysis and panel discussion.
tvmaze:9072.title: Erin Burnett OutFront

tvmaze:90756.overview: Unacceptable features Ed Gamble as host with two teams of comics battling to convince a studio audience of their most daft, niche, unwise or unacceptable views that they and their teammates must then defend.Joined by some of the biggest names in comedy each week, Unacceptable will see a live "swingometer" track how many audience members the teams win over with their wit and punchlines as they aim to convince the crowd, with Gamble introducing a series of challenges to force them to practice what they preach.
tvmaze:90756.title: Unacceptable

tvmaze:90831.overview: Do you think shopping should be considered an Olympic sport? Bargain hunt like it's a full-time job? Is retail therapy your form of … actual therapy?Then get ready for the shopping spree of a lifetime, because the new series Win the Mall is the ultimate fantasy retail experience. This high-stakes competition transforms a classic American shopping mall into a thrilling game of strategy and unexpected twists. Over the season, 10 teams of expert shoppers face off against each other as they attempt to gain control of storefronts, increase their spending power, and outmaneuver their rivals.
tvmaze:90831.title: Win the Mall

tvmaze:909.overview: Perry Mason is an attorney who specializes in defending seemingly indefensible cases. With the aid of his secretary Della Street and investigator Paul Drake, he often finds that by digging deeply into the facts, startling facts can be revealed. Often relying on his outstanding courtroom skills, he often tricks or traps people into unwittingly admitting their guilt.
tvmaze:909.title: Perry Mason

tvmaze:91004.overview: Bill's Included follows Bill Beam, a well meaning but over enthusiastic divorcee who rents his spare rooms to students to stay afloat.As Bill tries - and often fails to be both responsible landlord and honorary housemate, he and his mismatched lodgers muddle through chaos, growing pains and unexpected friendships.
tvmaze:91004.title: Bill's Included

tvmaze:91103.overview: Southern Law follows law enforcement officers across the South as they respond to calls, protect their communities, and face the realities of policing in one of the country's most dynamic regions.
tvmaze:91103.title: Southern Law

tvmaze:91119.overview: Kang Tae Ju, a former neurosurgeon who now serves as a hospital director engages in an extreme fight with a criminal with a human face to save his wife who was kidnapped right before divorce.
tvmaze:91119.title: The Husband

tvmaze:91133.overview: Set against the sweeping Northumberland coastline and its surrounding market towns, the series centres on an unlikely crime-solving duo.Joe Ruby, a jack-of-all-trades whose life has been shaped by mistakes, regrets and missed opportunities, alongside Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell, a rarefied intellectual, a deep thinker with a brilliant mind and an ice-cool disposition.In a classic odd-couple pairing, Joe and Rose combine their talents as they frustrate, confound and ultimately surprise one another while unravelling a series of compelling crime mysteries.
tvmaze:91133.title: The Northumbria Mysteries

tvmaze:91176.overview: A second-hand pair of earphones connects two rivals to the world of the dead. When their idol friend dies under mysterious circumstances, what starts as enemies forced to "fake date" turns into an undeniable bond as they become reluctant partners in a murder investigation. Before the killer... silences them as the next victims. The deeper they dig, the closer they get to death-and to each other. Until they can no longer tell which one is louder: the "voice of the dead" or the "sound of their racing hearts".
tvmaze:91176.title: Oops! Mysterious Sounds

tvmaze:9129.overview: Mastermind is a British quiz show, well known for its challenging questions, intimidating setting and air of seriousness. It first aired on 11 September 1972 & is still running today. Four contestants brave the black chair as they answer questions on their specialist subjects and test their general knowledge to win the coveted trophy.
tvmaze:9129.title: Mastermind

tvmaze:91301.overview: Philomena Cunk will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?
tvmaze:91301.title: Cunk on Cinema

tvmaze:91309.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.
tvmaze:91309.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White

tvmaze:9133.overview: Series showcasing the best of international documentary filmmakers works.
tvmaze:9133.title: Storyville

tvmaze:914.overview: The Bachelor is an American dating and relationship reality television series, revolving around a single former bachelor, who starts with a pool of candidates from whom the bachelor is expected to select a wife through an elimination process.
tvmaze:914.title: The Bachelor

tvmaze:91405.overview: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.
tvmaze:91405.title: NCIS: New York

tvmaze:91448.overview: Follows Choi Song I, the new manager of a family restaurant, who must step up to take charge after her father's sudden death. In a bid to save the restaurant, she becomes entangled in a fierce cooking competition alongside Kang Han, also known as "Chris K", a renowned overseas chef. Their journey brings them head-to-head with Cha U Jin, a perfectionist chef and Kang Han's fiercest rival, whose relentless ambition drives the intense rivalry. At the center of the competition is Seon Jeong Won, the executive producer of The Table: K Chef 2026, who orchestrates the high-stakes event to crown Korea's top chef. As the chefs compete, their personal stories and ambitions unfold, creating a dynamic and dramatic showdown of culinary mastery.
tvmaze:91448.title: Final Table

tvmaze:91451.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.
tvmaze:91451.title: A Love Other Than Yours

tvmaze:91584.overview: Chris, a young woman suffering from amnesia, is recovering and living with her loving partner, Nadia, after an accident four years ago. Everything seems to be going well, but then the arrival of a strange woman named Sun begins to shake Chris's beliefs.
tvmaze:91584.title: Third Person

tvmaze:91626.overview: Stephen Nolan joins officers from the Police Service of Northern Ireland as they patrol the streets of Belfast in Peelers: The PSNI for Real.The series reflects the realities of 24/7 policing and its many challenges – including street disorder, substance abuse and domestic violence.It also gives viewers a revealing sense of what it's like to be a police officer and the teamwork that's required in fast-changing and often uncertain situations.
tvmaze:91626.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real

tvmaze:9165.overview: Sean Hannity interviews political figures and newsmakers and offers his own perspective.
tvmaze:9165.title: Hannity

tvmaze:91677.overview: Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter marks the closing chapter of one of the most influential reality franchises of all time. For 15 years, Love & Hip Hop built stars, sparked conversation, and helped define the modern reality television era. Now, cast, creators, and cultural voices come together for a definitive look back – celebrating its impact, unpacking its most talked-about moments, confronting the controversies that shaped the conversation, and examining its legacy.
tvmaze:91677.title: Love & Hip Hop: The Final Chapter

tvmaze:91789.overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.
tvmaze:91789.title: Newlyweds

tvmaze:91839.overview: Sometimes we feel like we know more about their lives than we do about our own. Their names are on everyone's lips. They are famous. They are stars. But all stars fade sooner or later. And humans too die. However, the death of a famous person is an event that leaves no one indifferent. They left us in different ways. Some left young, in the prime of their creative powers. Others lived long and fruitful lives. But no matter when they passed, their death is an irreparable loss for the entire country. In its new program, "How Idols Passed Away," DTV will reveal unknown details of the final days of great Russian figures, idols of recent times—outstanding actors and directors, poets and writers, TV presenters, and masters of sport.
tvmaze:91839.title: Как уходили кумиры

tvmaze:91885.overview: House Shock, unsuspecting homeowners nominated by their sneaky loved ones will receive surprise makeovers for the spaces they've neglected, abandoned or just plain hate. Series host and designer Arielle Vandenberg along with a resourceful construction team led by builder and former Battle on the Beach winner Steve Lewis will keep each edge-of-your-seat renovation on track and on time. With secret planning, stealthy distractions to keep the recipient away, hidden cameras and dramatic room reveals, the 20-episode season will deliver heart, humor and the occasional shock—because not every reno surprise is exactly what a homeowner wished for.
tvmaze:91885.title: House Shock

tvmaze:91901.overview: The Moment with Katy Tur is designed to move beyond the immediate headlines to provide deeper context and understanding of the political and national stories shaping the day.
tvmaze:91901.title: The Moment with Katy Tur

tvmaze:91902.overview: On the Line with Alicia Menendez moves beyond the headlines to examine the stories shaping the nation, featuring one-on-one conversations with newsmakers and a focus on voices often left out of the political discourse
tvmaze:91902.title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez

tvmaze:91903.overview: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle, utilizing her extensive Wall Street background to analyze the high-stakes intersection of money, power, and politics, Stephanie Ruhle delivers original reporting and hard-hitting interviews on the stories that directly affect Americans' lives. The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour
tvmaze:91903.title: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle

tvmaze:9215.overview: ESPN's award-winning Fantasy Football Now airs live on Sunday mornings during the NFL season, a time when fans are making last-minute roster moves and need the latest news from around the league. Providing it are host Robert Flores, analysts Matthew Berry and Tim Hasselbeck, and physical therapist Stephania Bell, who gives injury updates. Anchor Sara Walsh, ESPN NFL insiders Adam Schefter and Chris Mortensen and NFL team reporters from game sites are also regular contributors to the show.
tvmaze:9215.title: Fantasy Focus Countdown

tvmaze:92156.overview: Depicts the romance between a man who once was a swimmer but lost his left leg to illness and a woman who, after losing her way as a medical resident, finds a new path as a graduate student. Park Min Jae, a man who lost his promising swimming career and his left leg to osteosarcoma. After hitting rock bottom, he discovers a new purpose in robotics. Four years of dedication pay off when he is accepted into the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Seoul National University. He hides his sensitivity behind a nonchalant facade, but he's actually just a simple guy who has dating on his bucket list. Im Yu Jin, who is on the verge of graduating from the Department of Clothing and Textiles when she gets caught up in an incident and fails in her attempt to enter graduate school; she then becomes fascinated by robotics and enrolls in a master's program in mechanical engineering.
tvmaze:92156.title: Between Steps

tvmaze:922.overview: Who's the toughest in the house? The Ultimate Fighter finds out as mixed martial arts fighters battle it out for a six-figure UFC contract. With two of the top UFC fighters as coaches, contestants will try to kick and punch their way to dominance and to prove who is The Ultimate Fighter.
tvmaze:922.title: The Ultimate Fighter

tvmaze:92278.overview: Lot Patrol follows a mismatched squad of eccentric security guards as they patrol the chaotic backlot of a major Hollywood studio, wrangling unhinged actors, rogue crew members, and their own wildly dysfunctional personal lives.
tvmaze:92278.title: Lot Patrol

tvmaze:92321.overview: In the late 1970s, Liu Haizhu, a young man from Songliao, intervenes to uphold justice and is swept into a jianghu conflict, where he forges a bond of life and death with Dong Batian. Through shifting times, he moves from an ordinary worker to a man entangled in the underworld, navigating brotherhood, tangled love and hate, and moral choices. He ultimately finds self-growth and redemption amid the ice and black soil.
tvmaze:92321.title: Northern Storm

tvmaze:92336.overview: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he's reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!
tvmaze:92336.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

tvmaze:92456.overview: The end of the 80s, a time of change and high hopes. Vera, the director of the House of Culture, launches the country's first beauty contest, despite the displeasure of officials. But against the background of the collapse of the country, it is under threat of closure — the country has no money for beauty. In an attempt to find a solution, Vera makes a deal with criminals, falling into a dangerous trap.
tvmaze:92456.title: Красота

tvmaze:92484.overview: Ride along as officers face the dangers and decisions that define the night shift.
tvmaze:92484.title: Late Night Law

tvmaze:92488.overview:
In a luxury house, everything is arranged for a comfortable life: spacious rooms, a warm pool, a well-groomed territory... And most importantly, there is money in the house! The bank is replenished every day thanks to the joint efforts of the participants.There is only one way to break this impressive jackpot — to successfully leave the house. Whichever player does it first, the entire budget will be transferred to that account. 
All entrances and exits, windows and any possible loopholes in the house are securely closed, which means that the participants will not just have to look for a way to freedom, but build a subtle strategy. Interestingly, the smart home itself is also a full-fledged hero of the project. He can ironically communicate with the characters at breakfast and challenge them during the trials.
tvmaze:92488.title: Идеальное ограбление

tvmaze:92492.overview: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago's powers.
tvmaze:92492.title: Black Torch

tvmaze:92553.overview: To repay his father's debt, Pao Bei is forced to work at the mansion of the cold and wealthy P'Eng. Bound by a contract, the two go from mutual dislike to becoming increasingly drawn to each other. When a stolen diamond ring exposes dark secrets within P'Eng's powerful family, the wounds hidden beneath his icy exterior gradually come to light. Meanwhile, Pao Bei's best friend Jiang Weibang unexpectedly reunites with his former rival Li Milan, who is now a popular celebrity. They immediately fall back into their old habit of trading barbs, only to find themselves attracted to each other all over again. Two couples, two fated romances—from bitter rivalry to love completely out of control!A new adaptation of the best-selling novel by ""Cutie Pie"" author BamBam.
tvmaze:92553.title: Not yours

tvmaze:926.overview:
Are you ready for the lockdown?

Ghost Adventures crew -- Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley, and Jay Wasley -- is back to investigate the scariest, most notorious, haunted places in the world.

The trio will interview eyewitnesses and historians at each location, arming themselves with the stories of the ghosts they will later provoke and confront during their dusk-to-dawn lockdowns. (Note: They don't always come out unscathed!) Then they'll review and analyze their findings with some the most respected experts and specialists in the paranormal field.
tvmaze:926.title: Ghost Adventures

tvmaze:92621.overview: Melody may be the heroine and saint destined to save the world from a rising demon king–but all she wants to do is become a perfect maid! Reincarnated in a story-based video game, Melody veers off the set story path, refusing to heed the call to action and instead using her powers to clean. Her new world becomes increasingly chaotic, and the story? Totally unhinged and unpredictable.
tvmaze:92621.title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!

tvmaze:92633.overview: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.
tvmaze:92633.title: The D Dorm

tvmaze:92689.overview: Smart, clever, and resourceful, Dan worked hard to overcome being poor. But his cheap ways are getting on the last nerve of his coworker Saint who hates him! After an incident with his own impoverished parents, Dan is suddenly growing closer to Saint while balancing feelings for his former tutor, James. With mixed emotions and unspoken secrets, will Dan be rich with love or fall back into poverty?
tvmaze:92689.title: My Secret Boyfriends

tvmaze:92696.overview: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.
tvmaze:92696.title: TFI Unplugged

tvmaze:92715.overview: A group of individuals becomes cyber protectors against modern digital threats. Cybercrime investigations with field operations, intense combat scenes, and technologically driven missions.
tvmaze:92715.title: Taskforce Firewall

tvmaze:92838.overview: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental S.W.A.T. unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city — and saving the program that made him who he is.
tvmaze:92838.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles

tvmaze:92844.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.
tvmaze:92844.title: Overgeared

tvmaze:92857.overview: After a tragedy destroys his life, a humble diner owner swallows the soul of the true king to gain extraordinary powers. With exactly one hundred days until his own soul is consumed, he embarks on a dangerous quest to defeat a tyrannical usurper, overthrow corrupt conglomerates, and help his host reclaim the throne.
tvmaze:92857.title: Crowned in a Hundred Days

tvmaze:92861.overview: An arrogant, brilliant teenager arrives at a prestigious Chinese restaurant in Tokyo to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish. Operating under the brutal philosophy that "cooking is a battle," he engages in high-stakes culinary duels, clashing with rival chefs who believe food should be made with heart and care.
tvmaze:92861.title: Iron Wok Jan!

tvmaze:92871.overview: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.
tvmaze:92871.title: Balaraw

tvmaze:92881.overview: Zong Yao, the vice minister of the Court of Judicial Review who is disguised as a man, solves numerous cases with intelligence. When her true identity is exposed and she is falsely accused of deceiving the emperor, she meets a tragic death. Surprisingly, her spirit does not dissipate. She wakes up floating by the bathtub of Lin Zhao—a talented scholar in the capital, the son of the prime minister, and a man of high status. She finds herself unable to move more than five steps away from him, while he is elated to see her—his secret crush for years—even as a ghost. She examines her past and realizes that her downfall is actually due to her investigation into the mutilation of a young girl in a brothel, which offended a hidden force. To help her clear her name, Lin, who has no interest in politics, enters officialdom. Together with her colleague Zhou Yin, they travel to Jin County in Yunnan to expose the Tiansheng Palace, which is using the guise of "holy maiden ascension" to commit crimes. During their investigation, Zong's spirit materializes, exposing a massive political conspiracy.
tvmaze:92881.title: The Ghost of Justice

tvmaze:92916.overview: An Exclusive, insiders look at the hottest residential properties in the Chicagoland market.
tvmaze:92916.title: Open House Chicago

tvmaze:92991.overview: Five aspiring performers compete for a coveted music industry opportunity, only to discover that their greatest strength lies in collaboration rather than rivalry. As they navigate friendship, self-doubt and the pressures of pursuing a music career, they form a band and chart their own path to stardom.
tvmaze:92991.title: L.O.L. Surprise! The Next Headliner

tvmaze:92997.overview: The series takes audiences on a high-energy journey across America's most iconic highway, combining adventure, competition, entertainment, community celebration, and philanthropy.
tvmaze:92997.title: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition

tvmaze:93029.overview: Two young boys… the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom – a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.
tvmaze:93029.title: Suikoden: The Anime

tvmaze:93090.overview: Kidnappings erupt simultaneously across seven Asian cities. Families of the victims receive a chilling email: "How far will you go to save your loved one?" Each participant is given different instructions, forced to overcome trials to rescue those they love. Seven people from diverse nationalities, backgrounds, and religions are drawn into a brutal survival contest under extreme conditions—the deadly "kiDnap GAME."
tvmaze:93090.title: kiDnap GAME

tvmaze:9311.overview: On All In with Chris Hayes, Chris Hayes delivers impactful stories that don't always make the front page. Drawing from his background as a reporter, Hayes goes on the road to uncover the truth by knocking on doors, digging deeper and speaking with people representing all points of view.
tvmaze:9311.title: All In with Chris Hayes

tvmaze:9312.overview: Drawing upon his experience as a former chief of staff on the Senate Finance Committee and as an Emmy-winning executive producer and writer of The West Wing, O'Donnell gives the last word and rewrites the most compelling stories of the day on The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell.
tvmaze:9312.title: The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell

tvmaze:93193.overview: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .
tvmaze:93193.title: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan

tvmaze:93208.overview: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...
tvmaze:93208.title: Zeri Feisheng

tvmaze:93243.overview: BattleBots Pro League powered by Bright Data is the toughest robot combat event on the planet. 24 elite bots from across the globe converge on Las Vegas for the ultimate fight to the death. There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.
tvmaze:93243.title: BattleBots Pro League

tvmaze:93263.overview: Yaga follows Rapp, a private investigator who arrives in a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park. Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.
tvmaze:93263.title: Yaga

tvmaze:93322.overview: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.
tvmaze:93322.title: GuAn

tvmaze:93333.overview: In restaurant kitchens around the world, elite chefs must work as a team every night to perfectly execute their dishes under intense pressure and in the new competition series Bobby Flay's The Line, the culinary icon pulls back the curtain on the high-stakes reality of working on a restaurant line. Each week, Bobby leads his hand-picked home team of extraordinary chefs Antonia Lofaso, Michael Jenkins and Claudette Zepeda against some of the country's most acclaimed restaurant staffs to execute a flawless dinner service – all for real diners in real time. The dueling lines must deliver dishes to diners and VIP guests, who rate each plate. After the ratings roll in, the lines can then choose to pivot their strategy based on that feedback. The home team's reputation is at stake to secure the win, but if the visiting team prevails, they will win $25,000.
tvmaze:93333.title: Bobby Flay's The Line

tvmaze:93350.overview: If you cross the line any further, Team Leader... I don't know what I'll do.A romantic and entangled story set in a workplace environment between an employee and his team leader/boss.
tvmaze:93350.title: Twisted Tie

tvmaze:93364.overview: "Anatomy of a Crime" is a Greek crime anthology series inspired by real-life crimes that shocked Greek society.Each episode reconstructs a different criminal case, exploring not only the crime itself, but also the events, human relationships, and motives that led to it. Passion, jealousy, revenge, family conflicts, and personal struggles gradually unfold, revealing the darker side of seemingly ordinary people.Featuring different characters and actors in each story, with Grigoris Valtinos serving as the narrator, the series combines crime drama with a psychological exploration of the circumstances and motivations behind each crime.The series aired on ANT1 from 1992 to 1995 and was one of the first Greek television productions to adapt real criminal cases into fictionalized television stories.
tvmaze:93364.title: Ανατομία ενός εγκλήματος

tvmaze:93370.overview: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.
tvmaze:93370.title: Current with Christine Romans

tvmaze:93429.overview: State of Play focuses on authoritative and original reporting, thoughtful conversations, and in-depth analysis of the biggest political and national stories shaping the day,
tvmaze:93429.title: State of Play with Peter Alexander

tvmaze:93434.overview: Humorous guessing game where Olli Wermskog invites famous guests to place events and things in the correct order.
tvmaze:93434.title: Rett skal være rett

tvmaze:93482.overview: Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew. Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.
tvmaze:93482.title: The Eternal Supreme, Li Yunxiao

tvmaze:93556.overview: Peacock NBA Monday is an exclusive weekly streaming broadcast block on Peacock featuring up to three live regular-season NBA games every Monday night, preceded by a dedicated 30-minute pre-game studio show.
tvmaze:93556.title: Peacock NBA Monday

tvmaze:93557.overview: Coast 2 Coast Tuesday is an NBA on NBC prime-time doubleheader format featuring an eastern/central regional game at 8:00 p.m. ET followed by a late-night western matchup starting at 11:00 p.m. ET (or 8:00 p.m. PT), bridging coast-to-coast basketball action across NBC and Peacock.
tvmaze:93557.title: Coast 2 Coast Tuesday

tvmaze:93603.overview: 12 celebrity students will learn the art of baking with the help of the country's best chefs and pastry chefs. Who will emerge as the winner of the "Baking School" Golden Rolling Pin? Hosted by Eyvind Hellstrøm, Truls Svendsen, and Wenche Andersen.
tvmaze:93603.title: Bakeskolen

tvmaze:93616.overview: Life in Breendonk is hell and escape seems impossible. To survive there, Rik and Leon make a pact with Flemish SS guard Vaes (Kevin Janssens), who claims to regret his collaboration. What they don't know is that Vaes is playing a double role, secretly passing intelligence to the SS. As the war devastates, the lives of Elisabeth, Rik and Vaes become dangerously intertwined. Who will protect whom? Who will betray whom?
tvmaze:93616.title: Breendonk

tvmaze:93628.overview: "Burden of Proof" is daily programming that focuses on the most talked-about trials. A panel of ABC News legal experts and analysts will discuss the facts of the cases in the headlines.
tvmaze:93628.title: Burden of Proof

tvmaze:93629.overview: Doctor's Note will providing medical facts, context and analysis of health trends, habits and myth-busting claims to help viewers live a happier, healthier and safer life.
tvmaze:93629.title: Doctor's Note

tvmaze:93642.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.
tvmaze:93642.title: Fool in Love

tvmaze:93684.overview: Five fan-favorite couples from the hit Love After Lockup franchise will join psychiatrist and nationally recognized relationship expert, Dr. Ish Major, to repair their broken bonds.
tvmaze:93684.title: Love After Lockup: Relationship Rehab

tvmaze:93724.overview: When an aspiring music producer teams up with a veteran mogul, the unlikely duo sets out to conquer the Mandopop scene.
tvmaze:93724.title: The Producer

tvmaze:93731.overview: CBP and HSI respond to a surge in cocaine trafficking across U.S. land borders and at sea, which leads to boat chases, arrests and record-setting seizures...
tvmaze:93731.title: To Catch A Smuggler: Contraband Capture

tvmaze:93733.overview: Bulan, a woman with a mysterious aura, crosses paths with Peem, a police officer desperate to solve a case for which the law offers no answers. Recommended as the only one capable of helping her, Bulan awakens in Peem doubts, attraction, and an unexpected bond that will challenge her beliefs and her understanding of justice.
tvmaze:93733.title: Khom Khlang

tvmaze:93741.overview: The stories that lie within the cards come to life...
tvmaze:93741.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Game The Chronicles

tvmaze:93756.overview: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.
tvmaze:93756.title: The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster

tvmaze:9377.overview: National, international and local news from the BBC Alba team.
tvmaze:9377.title: An Là

tvmaze:93776.overview: Paolo's ordinary working-class existence is upended when he encounters the ambitious, and magnetic local politician Téophane, an old school mate. What begins as admiration and a desire to help Téophane's campaign, soon spirals into an all-consuming obsession, leading to a deadly ride in this intense psychological Ripley-style thriller.
tvmaze:93776.title: Paolo

tvmaze:93777.overview: Everyday life is full of things to be happy about, you just have to notice them. Every Monday for 52 weeks, we present a new source of excitement.
tvmaze:93777.title: Kilder til begeistring

tvmaze:93785.overview: As Big Brother returns this autumn on ITV2 and ITVX for its biggest series yet, Big Brother: The Group Chat will give fans even more action, bringing them closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the series. With exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests, viewers can expect strong opinions, plenty of personality and the inside scoop from those who know the house best.From the biggest moments to the hot topics sparking conversation, Kate and GK will be on hand to dissect the drama, celebrate the stand-out scenes and weigh in on the decisions and surprises shaping the game. Whether it's an unexpected shake-up, an unlikely alliance or a moment that has everyone talking, Big Brother: The Group Chat will be the place to continue the conversation after Big Brother each night.
tvmaze:93785.title: Big Brother: The Group Chat

tvmaze:93786.overview: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.
tvmaze:93786.title: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena

tvmaze:93787.overview: The new series follows former "Flipping Out" star Jeff Lewis as he navigates the demands of his hit SiriusXM show on Radio Andy, an eponymous design empire, and everything in-between.   The king of controlled chaos with a charged personality, Jeff is as outspoken as ever, but this time the mic is always on. As he works to balance his professional and personal lives, his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him and still somehow survive him.
tvmaze:93787.title: Still Flipping Out

tvmaze:93792.overview: Youth follows a 50-year-old divorcee's search for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.
tvmaze:93792.title: Youth

tvmaze:93826.overview: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.
tvmaze:93826.title: Dive into You

tvmaze:93828.overview: NFL Play Action brings a fresh, dynamic energy to game week, pairing Brandt's football pedigree with Love's fluency of sports, fashion, and entertainment. Together, they'll anchor the can't-miss weekly cultural recap of NFL football this fall, spotlighting the biggest storylines, stars, and moments both on and off the field.
tvmaze:93828.title: NFL Play Action

tvmaze:93837.overview: Crime Scene Raw focuses on a different high-profile case each episode, utilizing police bodycam footage and forensic evidence.
tvmaze:93837.title: Crime Scene Raw

tvmaze:93848.overview: The legendary bishoujo game "Magical★Explorer"I was reincarnated not as the protagonist surrounded by heroines thanks to my cheat abilities, but as Takine Kousuke, the unfortunate friend character who just puts on a forced smile beside them ...!In the original game, he's inconspicuous, unrewarded, and remains a supporting character until the very end. But I have the knowledge from my past life, having played this game to its fullest extent! Furthermore, this friend character has a hidden ability: "the world's highest magical power," potentially surpassing even the protagonist...?In order to lead the heroines he has longed for and met in this world to happy endings, his friend Kousuke fights his way through this world!
tvmaze:93848.title: Magical Explorer

tvmaze:93859.overview: Everyone's favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.
tvmaze:93859.title: Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles

tvmaze:93881.overview: Helene and Carl trade their home in Stockholm's archipelago for a sun-drenched villa in Sicily, swapping lives for some weeks with Scarlett and Adam; a couple they've never met. But as they settle into each other's houses, unsettling details begin to surface. As secrets emerge and hidden betrayals come to light, what started as a picture‑perfect escape slowly warps into a twisted game of surveillance, manipulation and mistrust.
tvmaze:93881.title: Bytet

tvmaze:93891.overview: In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?!A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.
tvmaze:93891.title: Eigyou Desukara
