tvmaze:93925.overview: A love story takes place on an Charo Island in Japan between South Korean Lee Yoo-Bin and Japanese Karin Shirahama. Lee Yoo-Bin failed big as a space planner in South Korea, while Karin Shirahama is a berry farmer, who suffers from an unknown illness.
tvmaze:93925.title: Merry Berry Love

tvmaze:93936.overview: Big Day with Peter Schrager will originate from New York City and cover the biggest stories from across the sports world each day, blending reporting, interviews, unique perspectives and authentic conversations with the athletes, coaches, executives and personalities driving the day's biggest headlines. While fans can expect Schrager's trademark NFL insight and relationships, Big Day is built to celebrate the full sports landscape and the moments everyone will be talking about.
tvmaze:93936.title: Big Day with Peter Schrager

tvmaze:93940.overview: Strawberry's cozy neighborhood bakery is officially open, and her Berry Besties are always popping by. Sometimes they're lending a helping hand, sometimes they're hungry customers and sometimes they're just swinging by for a snack and some fun together. Whether she's whipping up desserts in her homey kitchen and bake shop, hosting friends in her snug upstairs apartment or throwing a sunshiney garden party out front, Strawberry brings the sweet warmth of a baked treat into every moment … and she's always ready for whatever friend stops by next.
tvmaze:93940.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Bake Shop

tvmaze:93941.overview: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, The One About Matthew Perry reveals the real Matthew Perry - generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life - and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon.
tvmaze:93941.title: The One About Matthew Perry

tvmaze:93951.overview: Sweet Deceit challenges teams of three competitors to search for deceptive, hyper-realistic sweets hiding in plain sight in real-world locations. Actor Josh Peck, who hilariously commands the on-screen hijinks as he leads contestants through four rounds as they try to identify masterfully disguised sweets created by world-class cake artists. Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.
tvmaze:93951.title: Sweet Deceit

tvmaze:93980.overview: Together with a celebrity guest in the studio, Jon and Judi will chew over the drama, celebrate the standout moments and revisit all the action from inside the Bake Off tent.
tvmaze:93980.title: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings

tvmaze:94016.overview: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?
tvmaze:94016.title: Till I See You

tvmaze:94085.overview: Shanghai, 1936. Mei Yuhe, a seamstress who works for the wealthy elite, takes matters into her own hands after her younger sister's mysterious death, personally dissecting the body. Together with Ding Zhao, a loan shark, she pieces together the scandalous secrets of high society, exposing the sordid sexual networks hidden beneath the neon lights.
tvmaze:94085.title: When the Lights Rise

tvmaze:94124.overview: An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover. Yun I Jun is a quirky third-generation chaebol raised in a sheltered environment who becomes a prime suspect in the mysterious murder of his previous secretary. When a new "male" secretary arrives to take the position, he has no idea that she's hiding a major secret. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae Hui, a former special forces officer turned police officer renowned as a "human weapon" for her exceptional strength and combat skills, disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yun I Jun's personal secretary and bodyguard. While protecting him, she secretly investigates him, setting the stage for unexpected chemistry, hidden identities, and plenty of comedic tension.
tvmaze:94124.title: Love in Disguise

tvmaze:94223.overview: Héctor Parrado's boat sank with crew; no bodies recovered. Families left in limbo. Lucía, Maca, Rosa, Berta, Paloma bond through loss. Two years later, the five fishermen return alive, bringing joy, conflicts, and buried secrets.
tvmaze:94223.title: A la deriva

tvmaze:94325.overview: What happens in Vegas usually stays in Vegas, but behind the flashing lights and million-dollar jackpots is a world visitors have never seen before. For the first time, Discovery pulls back the curtain on the legendary Golden Nugget, one of Las Vegas' most iconic casinos, to follow the larger-than-life personalities responsible for managing demanding high rollers, millions of dollars, and nonstop drama every day. Just off the chaos of busy Fremont Street, cameras capture the real-life and often shocking moments that unfold around the clock: unruly guests, high-pressure special events and the relentless efforts required to keep thousands of people safe and entertained each day. Whether it's breaking up a late-night club brawl, responding to an embarrassing medical emergency or racing to move sharks from a 200,000-gallon shark tank, the staff must be ready for whatever Vegas throws their way.
tvmaze:94325.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino

tvmaze:94330.overview: Bound by decades of shared history, fallouts and friendship, this fan-favorite group of New Yorkers are starting fresh together in the Sunshine State.
tvmaze:94330.title: The Golden Life

tvmaze:94362.overview: In American sports television's longest-running exclusive single-school media partnership, NBC Sports captures the pride, tradition, and home-field drama of the independent Fighting Irish live from iconic Notre Dame Stadium.
tvmaze:94362.title: Notre Dame Football on NBC

tvmaze:94370.overview: A story about the love and relationships of people in an office, a place that is not only a workplace but also a place where someone's feelings are made clear.
tvmaze:94370.title: New Boyfriend

tvmaze:94373.overview: Sirens. Smoke. Fire. Life-saving decisions when every second counts. In a raw and unscripted look behind the uniform, cameras follow the first responders of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire brigade as career professionals and volunteers risk everything to navigate high-stakes emergencies, intense high-pressure rescues, and the personal toll of life on the front lines.
tvmaze:94373.title: Brandweer 010

tvmaze:94382.overview: Depicts the story of Yeon Su, a woman raised in a conservative household who works at a marketing company and has lived her life while maintaining her chastity, as she meets a man who is the CEO of an adult product company. As their worlds collide, they challenge each other's beliefs and grow together in unexpected ways.
tvmaze:94382.title: Make Me Tremble

tvmaze:94388.overview: The story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by the demon race, who is ordered by his master to leave the Black and White Mountain to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. In the process of investigating the truth, he gradually uncovers the story of the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny.
tvmaze:94388.title: Raised by Demons: Panda Li

tvmaze:94415.overview: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!
tvmaze:94415.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint

tvmaze:94430.overview: The reality competition, hosted by Parker Posey, follows a group of celebrities in a lavish Italian villa as they shake down, hustle, and whack their way to win up to $250,000.Every episode, they will tackle mob movie-inspired jobs to survive. But every mob family needs a don, and whoever they choose will have absolute power — deciding who makes money, who stays, and who ultimately gets whacked.
tvmaze:94430.title: The Mob

tvmaze:94452.overview: Amid the glamour and privilege of Rio de Janeiro's elite, art collector Lúcia Rossetti and her daughter, Maíra Rossetti, are caught in a complex and turbulent relationship. When their lives intersect with Irina, a web of secrets, tensions and mysteries begins to unfold.
tvmaze:94452.title: Dom de Iludir

tvmaze:94455.overview: John Bishop hosts as players take on the audience to win up to £30,000. The science says the audience should win. But will anyone manage to steal it by beating the wisdom of the crowd?
tvmaze:94455.title: Wisdom of the Crowd

tvmaze:94484.overview: Each episode sees three junior geniuses (the Tiny Big Brains) paired with three different comics who try their best not to scupper the Tiny Big Brains' chances of victory!
tvmaze:94484.title: Jack Dee's Help Me Tiny Big Brain

tvmaze:94493.overview: "Find Senki," those were the final words of Kairi's grandfather and now his mission. DARK MACHINE, a new and captivating eSport game, transformed Japan's economy. The most powerful player controls it with the title Senki. Now, on the seventh Senki, Kairi plays to finally meet them and ultimately take claim. Will he be able to hold his own, though?
tvmaze:94493.title: Dark Machine: the Animation

tvmaze:94494.overview: Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu, girls from separate schools, find themselves linked together as they fall through the floor during a field trip to the Tokyo Tower. They land in a place called Cephiro, where their will controls what happens. They meet with Guru Clef and find out that they were summoned to save Princess Emeraude who has been imprisoned by High Priest Zagato. They learn magic and acquire weapons on their quest to save Cephiro from the evils of Zagato.
tvmaze:94494.title: Magic Knight Rayearth

tvmaze:94495.overview: After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.
tvmaze:94495.title: Romelia War Chronicle

tvmaze:94497.overview: Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!
tvmaze:94497.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?

tvmaze:94517.overview: It's the modern world, where humans, yokai, and various other races coexist. Satoru, who works as the apartment manager, ends up angering his secret crush, Mifuyu, a snow woman who lives in the same building. Eager to make amends, he uses a mysterious ring that is said to help in communicating with yokai. However, he finds himself hotly pursued by Mifuyu, who has suddenly become extremely forward.
tvmaze:94517.title: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring

tvmaze:94518.overview: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.
tvmaze:94518.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers

tvmaze:94524.overview: Eliza Stamatiou lives with her mother, Margarita, and her younger brother, Giorgos, somewhere in Brahami. Their financial situation is very good and everyone at home has relative freedom of movement. Eliza works for a large insurance company, but her "secret" desire is to work in cinema, regardless of her specialty. In the boredom of everyday life and a rather indifferent life, Eliza juxtaposes her imagination, which has been fueled by endless hours in movie theaters or in front of the video. Her generally unsuccessful attempts to transfer elements and situations from movies and their corresponding heroines to her daily life, provoke laughter and emotion.
tvmaze:94524.title: Η Ελίζα και... οι Άλλοι

tvmaze:94527.overview: The series revolves around the fast-paced, dramatic, and humorous everyday life of the staff working at a fictional restaurant named Kotliarevskyi.
tvmaze:94527.title: Котляревський

tvmaze:94538.overview: Jude Derry arrives at this exclusive university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. The three heirs to the family empire dominate Tagus with a magnetism that no one can resist. There's Aegan, the charismatic and calculating firstborn, Adrik, the enigmatic and mysterious middle brother, and Aleixandre, the rebellious and unpredictable youngest.
tvmaze:94538.title: Perfectos mentirosos

tvmaze:94608.overview: Hosted by comedian Abi Clarke and presenter and Strictly alum Tyler West, Strictly: Lights Up will be available immediately after the results show has finished. Abi and Tyler will take viewers straight on to the Strictly dance floor for immediate reactions from the night's eliminated couple, their dance off opponents - plus the judges, hosts, other Strictly stars and studio guests.
tvmaze:94608.title: Strictly: Lights Up

tvmaze:94650.overview: Tells the story of an ordinary 18-year-old high school girl returning to reality after having her mysterious experiences on her summer vacation.
tvmaze:94650.title: Summer Vacation

tvmaze:94673.overview: Doozie is pinching into her very own Doghouse for some puppy-riffic adventures with her best pup Puggie and all her Doozie Dogs. From the creators of DreamWorks Animation's hit series Gabby's Dollhouse, Doozie's Doghouse is a mixed-media companion series that continues the fun with tail-wagging surprises, woof-tastic unboxings, and imaginative play. Creativity is limitless in Doozie's Doghouse!
tvmaze:94673.title: Doozie's Doghouse

tvmaze:94674.overview: Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.
tvmaze:94674.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden

tvmaze:94678.overview: What if you could actually use a mouse cursor in real life? Takumi, the nerdy outcast, harbors unrequited feelings for his first love, Mone, who treats him with disdain. During computer class, Takumi discovers that his mouse cursor extends beyond the screen and into the physical world...?! With this newfound power visible only to him, Takumi sees an opportunity for mischief. He uses the cursor to get revenge on Mone, clicking on sensitive areas and reveling in her reactions. But when an "Intercourse" button appears unexpectedly, Takumi is thrust into a reality he never imagined possible..."Intercourse"?! Could this really be...?!
tvmaze:94678.title: Now That I Can Control Reality with a Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away on the Girls!

tvmaze:94679.overview: Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human who uses demonic powers, is the newest addition to the party of the uptight priest Roni. Everyone expected the two to dislike each other and to have nothing to do with each other. But to their surprise, on their first day together as an adventuring party, they had a one-night stand...!
tvmaze:94679.title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner

tvmaze:94680.overview: Takeru Hidaka is an ambitious high school student aiming for medical school. He has just started dating his first girlfriend, Kaori Koga, and to everyone else, their relationship seems perfectly harmonious. However, that peace is threatened when Kaori's best friend, Tomoko Yoshioka, begins to flirt with and seduce Takeru. Caught between loyalty to his girlfriend and Tomoko's advances, Takeru falls into a double life and a complicated affair. Now, he must navigate a web of lies that puts both his academic future and his emotional connections at risk, all while the constant threat of his secret being exposed looms over him.
tvmaze:94680.title: My Girlfriend's Friend

tvmaze:94682.overview: Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night after a heart-fluttering date. The next day, they face each other at a police station with completely different memories. One of them is lying. With no evidence or witnesses, even the polygraph result defies expectations, and their mutual suspicion throws their lives into chaos. Questions about Joonho's late wife reveal that the case extends far beyond the two of them. As conflicting testimony and hidden relationships emerge, the truth grows murkier, and one lie sparks a dangerous game in which no one can be trusted.
tvmaze:94682.title: The Perfect Lie

tvmaze:94729.overview: Short on time and want something fast? Jamie Oliver shows us how to make gorgeous meals in just 20 minutes.
tvmaze:94729.title: Jamie's 20 Minute Meals

tvmaze:94735.overview: Krit, the polished CEO of a data analytics empire, has always put family and duty above his own heart. When a scandal linked to his ex-lover tarnishes his reputation, his controlling mother forces him into a fake marriage with Non—his adopted younger brother who has secretly loved him for years. What begins as a staged arrangement soon turns real as Non steps out of Krit's shadow and catches someone else's eye, awakening emotions Krit can no longer deny. But when their relationship sparks a public scandal, Krit must choose between protecting the perfect life he's built or risking everything for a love he never expected.
tvmaze:94735.title: Decoding You

tvmaze:94754.overview: Tutankhamun, Ramses the Great, Cleopatra, Khufu…these legendary pharaohs built the wonders of Karnak, Luxor and the pyramids of Giza before their civilisation faded into obscurity. But in 1798, Napoleon Bonaparte's expedition to Egypt reopened the doors to a forgotten world and ignited a fascination with Ancient Egypt that continues to this day. Bold explorers, such as Jean-François Champollion and Giovanni Battista Belzoni, risked everything to unearth these wonders. Archaeology became a conquest, and Egypt's heritage was plundered by tomb raiders - until Auguste Mariette laid the foundations of modern Egyptology. This immersive series reveals the splendour of the pharaohs and the feats of the explorers.
tvmaze:94754.title: Raiders of the Lost Pharaohs

tvmaze:94755.overview: UK Forensic Breakthroughs analyses ten of the UK's toughest murder cases, where forensic science was crucial in bringing the killer to justice.
tvmaze:94755.title: UK Forensic Breakthroughs

tvmaze:94766.overview: At Yang-Da University Hospital, Associate Director of Emergency Medicine Chou Cheng-chun makes a bold decision to accept Lin Geng-ming, an average-performing medical school graduate. Lin joins the emergency department as a resident alongside elite peers, Tang Hsi and Chiang Tung-yen, working shoulder to shoulder to save lives. Together with senior attending physician He Yu-hua, the ER team faces relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles within the hospital. Miracles of the ER delves into the complex dynamics between doctors and patients, patients and their families, revealing both the tension and the deep compassion that bind them all together.
tvmaze:94766.title: Miracles of the ER

tvmaze:94768.overview: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.
tvmaze:94768.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County

tvmaze:94772.overview: Will Mellor fronts this gripping true crime series, delving into five of the most shocking miscarriages of justice in legal history. Will unpacks how the system got it so disastrously wrong and reveals the crucial new evidence that finally set the wrongfully convicted, free. We hear from the falsely accused in their own words, providing an insight into what it's like to be arrested, tried and convicted of the most horrendous of crimes; and the subsequent battle to clear their name.
tvmaze:94772.title: Convictions Gone Bad with Will Mellor

tvmaze:94773.overview: The ladies are back and going even wilder! This season, they're taking their energy straight to Cancun for nonstop turn-ups, unforgettable nights, and plenty of unexpected moments along the way. With no telling what can happen when the girls hit the streets, beaches, and nightlife of Mexico, Cancun is about to experience Baddies Gone Wild like never before.
tvmaze:94773.title: Baddies Gone Wild: Cancun

tvmaze:94786.overview: Deadly Destinations chronicles the stories of unsuspecting travelers whose lives are tragically cut short, and gradually reveals how their final stop holds critical clues needed to catch their killer.
tvmaze:94786.title: Deadly Destinations

tvmaze:94793.overview: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?
tvmaze:94793.title: The Sound of Sugar Cubes

tvmaze:94797.overview: A disgraced journalist returns to her hometown and sets out to investigate the unsolved disappearance of a childhood friend.
tvmaze:94797.title: Zmora

tvmaze:94807.overview: In 2035, Song Yang, a top student specializing in AI, is falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend and her daughter. While on the run, he teams up with Ada, an android who has developed self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of mysterious cases and uncover the dark secrets of Cedar Group. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and Song Yang clears his name. Ada sacrifices herself to protect him, and humans and androids enter a new era of coexistence.
tvmaze:94807.title: Bionic Trace

tvmaze:94810.overview: A fast-paced, comprehensive look at the major issues driving the market, designed to help viewers navigate the complex financial forces shaping their future before the trading day begins.
tvmaze:94810.title: Big Money in the Morning

tvmaze:94833.overview: When the alarm sounds and everyone else seeks shelter, they cast off. We get a unique, raw glimpse into life aboard the rescue vessels—filmed by the crew themselves. These boats operate along the entire Norwegian coast to save lives and protect property.
tvmaze:94833.title: Mayday

tvmaze:94853.overview: Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product.As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.
tvmaze:94853.title: Second Plate

tvmaze:94865.overview: Thitinan will take any job—being a fake girlfriend and breaking up a relationship, or, special just for Miss Chat, becoming a bedroom coach.
tvmaze:94865.title: Love on Hire

tvmaze:94885.overview: Cosmo Speranza is the best art advisor in the business. He can tell whether a work of art is genuine or fake from even the smallest detail. An ability that proves useful when he finds himself working with Rome's Mobile Squad and Inspector Angelo Tiberi. The two are forced to work side by side, discovering that they make an unlikely yet highly effective investigative duo because, just like a painting, a crime scene can also be a forgery. And no one is better than Cosmo at spotting the clues that can bring down the house of cards built by a killer. But when a painting depicting his childhood home is found at a crime scene, it doesn't take Cosmo long to realise that the killer is speaking directly to him, prompting him to reopen the investigation into his father's suicide. A journey between past and present, where it seems impossible to tell truth from fiction.
tvmaze:94885.title: ChiaroScuro

tvmaze:94891.overview: Baby Animals Down Under takes you on a spectacular trek around Australia to meet a wide variety of delightful youngsters that hop, climb, fly and swim through its wilds. In Forests, go piggybacking with Koala joeys and enjoy the rare sight of a Tree Kangaroo joey popping its head out of the pouch. On the Waterways, see baby Saltwater crocodiles emerge from their eggs, and go for a paddle with fluffy baby Black Swans. In the Outback, bound around with Red Kangaroo joeys and Emu chicks. Visit the Islands to catch baby Quokkas and Tasmanian Devils at play. In the Bush, be intrigued by baby Echidnas, known as puggles, and go for a leisurely waddle with some Wombat joeys. Plus, don't miss Green Sea turtles scramble for the waves, or the chance to tag along with Humpback Whale calves as they cruise the Coast with their majestic mums.
tvmaze:94891.title: Baby Animals Down Under

tvmaze:94907.overview: Hosted by Teja Sajja, The Traitors is a brutal game of betrayal where 20 contestants face daily eliminations for a grand prize. Hidden among the innocent players are the traitors, striking to murder each night. In this high-stakes battlefield of trust, deception, and strategy - Trust is Uncool, Mosam Ikkada New Rule.
tvmaze:94907.title: The Traitors Telugu

tvmaze:94908.overview: Sam Lovegrove prepares cars and bikes for Britain's iconic motorsport events.
tvmaze:94908.title: Sam Lovegrove: Race Mechanic

tvmaze:94909.overview: Matt Baker returns to the family farm for an ambitious new chapter: transforming the old barn beside Matt's parents' farmhouse into a new home.
tvmaze:94909.title: Matt Baker: Our Barn in the Dales

tvmaze:94913.overview: In the quiet village of Pazos, Aniceto and his wife Irene appear to be the perfect couple until one night, when she suffers a brutal attack during an apparent robbery. As she fights for her life in the hospital, Elías, a sergeant in the Civil Guard who is convinced that Aniceto is the perpetrator, faces a system he perceives as unwilling to heed his warnings or protect the victim. With Aniceto free and Irene's life hanging by a thread, will the truth come to light before it's too late?
tvmaze:94913.title: El crimen de Pazos

tvmaze:94921.overview: On November 6, 1985, an M-19 guerrilla commando forcibly entered the Palace of Justice and took more than 300 people hostage, including Supreme Court justices. On November 7, the Colombian Army retook the Palace. Inspired by real and publicly known events, the series recounts what happened during the siege and retaking of the Palace of Justice, which resulted in the deaths and disappearances of at least 94 people, including justices, guerrilla members, civilians and members of the military. It also follows the victims' families in their pursuit of justice for more than 20 years.
tvmaze:94921.title: Palacio

tvmaze:94928.overview: Across the vast wilderness of Alaska, four unique women share one goal: to thrive in the harsh and unpredictable conditions of the frozen winter landscape. Ryne Olson trains reindeer for backcountry travel. Jody Potts-Joseph carries on the traditions of her Indigenous ancestors. Sarah Poynter subsists on a remote off-grid homestead. Kaycee Powell relies on dog power to stake her claim in the wild.
tvmaze:94928.title: Surviving Alaska: Women of the Wild

tvmaze:94937.overview: Gaspard and Lisa are best friends who get involved in many adventures and everyday situations in life. Sometimes they often cause troubles that make other people upset with them and when that happens they say "Uh oh! Catastrophe!", but when they fix the problem, they say, "Yes, triumph!".
tvmaze:94937.title: Gaspard et Lisa

tvmaze:94966.overview: An unscripted, immersive horror-interview series that pairs genre legends and celebrities with premier haunted attractions for terrifying, raw conversations while navigating jump scares.
tvmaze:94966.title: Celebrity Scares

tvmaze:94987.overview: Olympic gold medalist figure skater, TV personality and sports broadcaster Tara Lipinski will challenge Christmas fanatics to create Yuletide magic on a dime in HGTV's new competition series Big Bargain Holiday Showdown, in each of the festive six episodes, two teams of friends, family and neighbors will battle to prove who has the most holiday spirit without blowing their shoestring budget. With the help of DIY experts, Ashley Dixon and Clinton Tharp, the teams will have just 48 hours and $500 each to transform one room in their home into a stunning winter-themed wonderland using ingenious design hacks, custom projects and smart spending. Each deck-the-halls duel will be judged by holiday artist, designer and Glitterville Studios founder Stephen Brown and interior designer and 37th Burleigh founder Pelar Fullilove who will crown a Christmas champ and award bragging rights, a cash prize and a surprise from Santa.
tvmaze:94987.title: Big Bargain Holiday Showdown

tvmaze:94990.overview: Nick Cannon @ Night uses pop culture, current events, and personal stories to explore love, dating, relationships, health, and modern intimacy as they unfold in everyday life. Audience questions and real-life dilemmas drive the conversation, while doctors and professionals anchor each discussion with informed perspectives and practical advice.
tvmaze:94990.title: Nick Cannon @ Night

tvmaze:94991.overview: A satirical music video countdown show featuring three new absurd music videos every episode. Music and compositions by Zach Reino & Jess McKenna.
tvmaze:94991.title: MP3

tvmaze:94992.overview: Set inside a prominent megachurch, Church Wives follows two ambitious women who go to war for status and power when a coveted leadership role opens up. Polite competition escalates fast, turning committee meetings, fundraisers, and Bible studies into battlegrounds for manipulation and shifting alliances. As devotion gives way to ego, the congregation is caught in the fallout, and victory starts to matter more than faith itself.
tvmaze:94992.title: Church Wives

tvmaze:94993.overview: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.
tvmaze:94993.title: Prawo Bestii

tvmaze:94997.overview: Extreme weather events examined from the inside out, including Hurricane Helene, the December Tennessee tornado outbreak and the vicious Black Summer of Australian wildfires, charting how and why they happen and the devastation left behind using first-hand survivor and witness accounts and adrenaline-fuelled footage captured on the ground.
tvmaze:94997.title: Megastorm

tvmaze:95006.overview: Pulling back the curtain on the origin stories that made the most polarizing and provocative athletes in sports history.
tvmaze:95006.title: Everybody Hates

tvmaze:95024.overview: Smooth and tactful, Chen Wan can handle anything other than his feelings for Zhao Shengge. A business venture brings them together as partners, and Zhao Shengge unexpectedly begins making the first moves, gradually closing the distance Chen Wan has so carefully maintained. Will a secret love that never dared for hope finally bloom?
tvmaze:95024.title: Echo of a Letter

tvmaze:95025.overview: Alicia watches her life come undone when her husband, Aurelio, is found guilty and imprisoned for corruption, after videos surface implicating him in a sex scandal. With her family under public scrutiny, she decides to return to the legal profession after 20 years and rebuild her career to move forward. As she tries to reclaim her professional standing and support her teenage children in this new reality, Alicia begins to question what she wants out of life. A reunion with a past love and changes in her relationship with Aurelio will force her to make a decision: return to the life she once knew, or build a new one on her own terms.
tvmaze:95025.title: La Ley de Alicia

tvmaze:95031.overview: Kevin McCloud gears up for an exhilarating adventure, as he drives classic cars around the countries where they were made, exploring classic craftmanship, culture and cuisine.
tvmaze:95031.title: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips

tvmaze:95032.overview: From vampires and werewolves to demons and Frankenstein, Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths unpacks the origin story of our most legendary monsters —and tracks their staying power across the centuries. It's a historical journey to the mindsets that made them and how folklore and superstition has intersected with science and popular culture right up until today.
tvmaze:95032.title: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths

tvmaze:95045.overview: Private detective Jussi Vares investigates surprising disappearances related to the Turku underworld. Based on the bestselling books by Reijo Mäki.
tvmaze:95045.title: Vares 2.0

tvmaze:95047.overview: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.
tvmaze:95047.title: Demons' Crest

tvmaze:95053.overview: After years of successfully mucking around for a living, Hamish Blake has realised when it comes to practical skills, he doesn't have many. To remedy this, Hamish starts a business helping real people with jobs they really need done, for real money and putting himself firmly on the hook.Each week, Hamish recruits two equally underqualified personalities to join him in tackling a challenge none of them are remotely prepared for. From welding a trailer or catering a wedding to drywalling a salami shed and sewing costumes for a community theatre, Hamish and his team will jump in at the deep end and use their wits and lateral thinking to make up for the years of training and experience they're missing. At the end of each job, the client decides what the work is actually worth and how much, if anything, they're prepared to pay.Expect funny, hilarious and ridiculous moments with Hamish and his hapless employees, as they pick up genuinely useful skills, help everyday Australians and rediscover the satisfaction of learning something new.
tvmaze:95053.title: Unskilled Adult

tvmaze:95063.overview: Ever since his mother died in a fire, Terrence has drifted through life in a fog of apathy, terrified by any flame. The same nightmare haunts him every night, until he finally confronts his phobia. By overcoming his fear, Terrence becomes a Voyager, able to command fire and cross into Dreamland, the mysterious dimension where humanity's dreams and nightmares come to life.
tvmaze:95063.title: Dreamland

tvmaze:95072.overview: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.
tvmaze:95072.title: Bløff

tvmaze:95084.overview: One of a Kind Romance follows the story of an ordinary job-seeker whose everyday life is suddenly disrupted by a celebrated actor and a rising idol, leading to a romance brimming with personal desires.
tvmaze:95084.title: One of a Kind Romance

tvmaze:95103.overview: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.
tvmaze:95103.title: Francesca Next Door

tvmaze:95119.overview: History has spent decades investigating the mysteries that challenge what we know about the past, and what we think is possible. History's Mystery Files revisits the most unforgettable cases, from sacred discoveries and bizarre weapons to unsolved disappearances and high strangeness. Hosted by Jorge Garcia, each episode follows the clues, the evidence and the questions that refuse to go away.
tvmaze:95119.title: History's Mystery Files

tvmaze:95124.overview: Interior designer Megan Batoon and comedian Tim Chantarangsu taking exciting tours of unusual vacation homes and distinctive stays in destinations.
tvmaze:95124.title: Open House Outrageous

tvmaze:95133.overview: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal examines allegations of misconduct, abuse of power, favoritism and competition rigging that have shaken the pageant world. Former contestants and insiders, including Taylor Hale (Miss Michigan 2021/Miss USA contestant) Noelia Voigt (Miss USA 2023) and Brittany Mason (Miss Indiana 2008/Miss USA contestant) share their experiences as concerns around contestant safety, financial pressures, ownership disputes and leadership turmoil come into focus. The controversy intensifies at Miss Universe 2025 in Thailand, where a public confrontation leads to a contestant walkout and judge resigns ahead of the finals alleging finalists were pre-selected, while secret audio recordings and further controversies questions about the organization's integrity.
tvmaze:95133.title: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal

tvmaze:95134.overview: A weekly show hosted by actor Sally Lindsay, inviting viewers to switch off the outside world and enjoy a cosy night in for a fun and revealing conversation. The nation's best-loved TV stars are invited to unwind and open up about what made them who they are today, with never-heard-before behind-the-scenes stories and moments that shaped them.
tvmaze:95134.title: A Night in with Sally Lindsay

tvmaze:95143.overview:
Griff Rhys Jones takes on one of the world's most celebrated mountain ranges by train as he explores from Slovenia to France, uncovering how the Alps have shaped Europe's history, wars, trade, and communities.
From Hannibal's famous elephant crossing in 218 BC, to Napoleon's Alpine campaigns, pilgrim trails, medieval traders, and WWII Escape Routes, The Alps have played a pivotal role in some of humanities greatest historical moments and influenced the spread and survival of culture for centuries.Starting with the Alp's eastern end at the stunning Lake Bled and ending on the Mediterranean beaches of Nice in France, Griff will burrow deep into hidden war tunnels, gorge at world-famous cheese caves, scale death-defying ferrata climbs, and mingle with the people and stories of forgotten villages tucked away off the beaten path.
tvmaze:95143.title: Griff Across the Alps

tvmaze:95150.overview: After a decade of struggling as a science fiction writer, Li Zhiwei finally earns a nomination for the Galaxy Award with his novel *The Death of Mara*. However, during a celebration on a secluded island, he unexpectedly travels through time and discovers that he is destined to be stabbed to death with a steak knife at midnight. Everyone at the villa seems to be hiding something: Xiaotao, his longtime friend who demands writing credit for the novel; Sophie, his obsessive girlfriend; An'an, his troubled ex-girlfriend; and Mr. Dai, a copyright representative. With each of them under suspicion, Li Zhiwei uses a mysterious nursery rhyme to travel repeatedly through time, desperately searching for the killer and a way to escape his fate. As he pieces together the clues, he uncovers the truth behind the disappearance of a boy named Mara ten years earlier. Bullied at school and betrayed by his friends, Mara vanished amid a series of mysterious events involving overlapping timelines. Li Zhiwei gradually realizes that the helmeted figure and the dangers surrounding him are part of an elaborate scheme orchestrated by those closest to him. Xiaotao and An'an have already discovered the rules of time travel, while Mr. Dai is revealed to be Mara's father, who arranged the gathering to uncover the truth about his son's disappearance. Trapped in countless time loops, Li Zhiwei is forced to confront his own indifference and selfishness from the past. Ultimately, he finds a chance to make amends in a parallel timeline, bringing his journey of guilt, regret, and redemption to a close.
tvmaze:95150.title: Killing the Writer

tvmaze:95155.overview: In the heart of Texas Hill Country is the picture‑perfect town of Boerne where wealth, beauty, faith and family reign supreme. Centered on a tight-knit circle of glamorous women, this series follows their lives as they raise families, run ranches and farms and manage sparkling social calendars in a town rooted in rodeos and tradition. Behind the polished smiles and Sunday sermons, however, there are intimate relationships and forbidden romances that test loyalties and marriages, jeopardizing the town's pristine image and proving that perfection is far more complicated than anyone could imagine.
tvmaze:95155.title: Small Town Trouble: Texas

tvmaze:95159.overview: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy romance. From pet to lover, who falls first?
tvmaze:95159.title: Tamed

tvmaze:95163.overview: 2035. An investigative journalist informs the FSB and the GRU that he has discovered an AI assistant developed for criminals. After hacking the program, the heroes gain access to the archives of the world's major terrorist attacks. They are forced to implant neurochips in themselves in order to penetrate the darknet metaverse and stop the evil.
tvmaze:95163.title: Репортаж-2035

tvmaze:95165.overview: Across ten gripping episodes, Catfish Murders reveals the extreme lengths people will go to exploit trust and the deadly consequences when their lies spill into the real world.
tvmaze:95165.title: Catfish Murders

tvmaze:95180.overview: Mothers will do absolutely anything for their children. High-emotion and high-stakes stories where a mother's unconditional love twists into bloodshed, as matriarchs stop at nothing to protect or avenge their kids.
tvmaze:95180.title: Snapped: Killer Moms

tvmaze:95182.overview: The story follows Maeve, a brilliant corporate fixer sent to convince and seduce Hunter, a rumored murderer, into selling his family's estate. But when she discovers that the town's most feared man may actually be its most misunderstood, and the only person who can protect her from her dangerous ex-boyfriend, Maeve becomes entangled in Hunter's world.
tvmaze:95182.title: Charmed by a Southern Monster

tvmaze:95198.overview: Rise of the Rockstar Chef charts the rise of three of Britain's most influential culinary figures, Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal, whose drive, creativity and uncompromising pursuit of excellence helped transform modern British cuisine and placed it firmly on the global stage.This series is set against the backdrop of the ‘Cool Britannia' era of radical social and cultural change. The episodes will explore how the chefs' unwavering ambition and intense rivalry reshaped Britain's restaurant industry and redefined what it meant to be a fine dining chef, ultimately inspiring a generation around the world.Featuring candid testimony from the trio themselves, as well as those who witnessed the fights, fall-outs and feuds first-hand, including renowned food critics, maîtres d' and former commis chefs, the story culminates in an extraordinary on-screen reunion that brings the three chefs together for the first time in decades to revisit defining moments and confront the legacy of an era that reshaped British dining.
tvmaze:95198.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef

tvmaze:95205.overview: Cracks waiting for the day they finally shatter. Three paths of love, each marked by labels. A love that began like a ray of light… but was broken by wounds from the past. A pure love ready to protect and heal a broken heart. A love that feels like a shackle, surrendering one's heart completely to the power of true love.
tvmaze:95205.title: Love Bound

tvmaze:95206.overview: From savage jokes and wild stunts to outrageous pranks, questionable decisions, and unforgettable viral moments, each episode showcases the kind of social content you can't believe someone actually posted. With her fearless humor and unapologetic perspective, Ms. Pat brings her signature comedic style to the competition as three hilarious content creators go head-to-head for a cash prize.
tvmaze:95206.title: America's Funniest People

tvmaze:95221.overview: Modern-day heiress sisters Lin Zhaohua and Lin Yumian are transported into a period romance drama. Lin Zhaohua, the decisive and formidable CEO of a powerful conglomerate, becomes the long-lost biological daughter of the Chancellor's Mansion, who was separated from them for sixteen years. Her younger sister, Lin Yumian, who has suffered from chronic illness and paralysis for years, becomes the pampered adopted daughter who has enjoyed eighteen years of privilege—and finally gains the healthy body she has always wished for. After returning to the Chancellor's Mansion, Lin Zhaohua uses her intelligence and determination to navigate the treacherous imperial court. She wins over Xiao Jin, the puppet emperor whose power has been stripped away by the Empress Dowager. Together, they counterbalance the domineering Empress Dowager and the calculating Chancellor, turning the tide of court politics. Meanwhile, Lin Yumian travels to the countryside and falls for Gu Yanzhi, a gentle and refined scholar, unaware that he is actually the Chief of the Netherworld Sect, burdened by a deep-seated blood feud. As both couples become entangled in a web of love and conflict, political turmoil and martial-world dangers emerge one after another. Though their paths are riddled with schemes, and love often clashes with loyalty, the two sisters remain steadfastly devoted to one another, facing every challenge side by side.
tvmaze:95221.title: Love Beyond Palace Walls

tvmaze:95266.overview: Port Alberni has long been seen as just a gas stop on the way to Tofino. Now Bryan and Sarah Baeumler have 12 weeks to change that. With help from guest stars like Home Town's Ben & Erin Napier, and Scott McGillivray and Sarah Keenleyside, they surprise local changemakers with life-changing home renovations, culminating in an emotional grand re-opening that puts this underdog town back on the map.
tvmaze:95266.title: Home Town Takeover Canada

tvmaze:95271.overview: Adam Ray hosts as our favorite sitcom moments happen in real life; family chaos, workplace antics and holiday disasters deliver the laughter. Adam joins the action in Adam Guest Stars and picks his favorite clips in Adam's A-List.
tvmaze:95271.title: Cue the Laughs

tvmaze:95272.overview: Deep in the manosphere, an underground movement promises to unlock human potential - bulging muscles, bigger penises, eternal youth. At its center is Dr. Tony Huge, a guru pushing homemade biohacks on a devoted following willing to risk everything for the cause. When Leo & Longevity, a penis-enlargement expert and one of Tony's closest allies, is found dead in Thailand, alpha-male influencers become online sleuths, running wild with theories and questioning Tony Huge and his right-hand man, Connor Murphy. Soon, a darker pattern emerges: Leo isn't the first of the inner circle to die under mysterious circumstances. Will he be the last?
tvmaze:95272.title: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death

tvmaze:95282.overview: Follows single men and women seeking traditional, marriage-minded partnerships built on commitment and shared values as they embark on a relationship journey with real-world compatibility tests and eliminations.
tvmaze:95282.title: Chris Harrison's the Vow

tvmaze:95285.overview: Acclaimed actor Gu Yi Liang and rising star Wei Yan Zi are sworn rivals in the eyes of their fans. But when Wei Yan Zi accidentally discovers a fan community dedicated to shipping the two of them, he becomes hopelessly obsessed. Little does he know that the seemingly aloof Gu Yi Liang has already fallen for him. Believing Wei Yan Zi hates him, Gu can only watch over him from afar.
tvmaze:95285.title: My Rival & Me

tvmaze:95295.overview: Power, revenge and legacy collide when rebel Rudra targets Bhavani's matriarchal rule over Pernuru in this gripping drama from YRF.
tvmaze:95295.title: Akka

tvmaze:95296.overview: After a devastating breakup, Valentina decides to date one man from every zodiac sign. But the universe has other plans.
tvmaze:95296.title: Os 12 Signos de Valentina

tvmaze:9530.overview: College GameDay is an ESPN entertainment show previewing college football games. It first aired in 1987 with Tim Brando as host and Lee Corso and Beano Cook as commentators, giving an overview of college football games, but the show underwent a radical transformation beginning in 1993, and began incorporating live broadcasts. The official name of the show is College GameDay built by The Home Depot. There is a separate radio broadcast, ESPN Radio College GameDay, on ESPN Radio. Today, the only original cast member remaining is Lee Corso. Rece Davis serves as host and Kirk Herbstreit is Corso's counterpart. Starting in 2008, Desmond Howardhas been added to the cast in the show's introduction. Craig James served as an analyst from 1990 to 1995. Erin Andrews joined the GameDay crew as a co-host and contributor in 2010, replaced in 2012 by Samantha Ponder. On September 5, 2015, Rece Davis (also host of the college basketball version of GameDay), replaced Chris Fowler as host of the college football version, which itself started its 29th season on that day.The show is known for its prediction segment that appears on each broadcast. Typically there are three predictors: Corso, Herbstreit, and an invited guest, usually a celebrity, prominent athlete, or radio personality associated with the host university or school for that week. The end of the show always concludes with a catch phrase and prediction from Corso, who subsequently dons the mascot's headgear of the school he predicts to win the game, usually to the ire or excitement of local fans. Beginning with the 2013 season, GameDay airs for three hours on ESPN. Previously, beginning in 2010, the first hour of the show was broadcast on ESPNU at 9am ET, with the 2 remaining hours of the show on ESPN from 10am-noon ET.
tvmaze:9530.title: College GameDay

tvmaze:95305.overview: Overworked, Bai Luoru flees to a village. With local support, she heals her past and mother's bond to live again.
tvmaze:95305.title: Wherever Whoever Whatever

tvmaze:95308.overview: This season of Love Island Australia is getting VillaMaxxed with this new companion series. Direct from the Villa, drops of unseen and exclusive footage will give you VIP access to the Islanders - in real time, unfiltered and unpredictable.
tvmaze:95308.title: Love Island Australia: Unseen. Uncut

tvmaze:95310.overview: The engagement party of a group of friends turns deadly when someone is murdered.
tvmaze:95310.title: Fatal Game

tvmaze:95314.overview: Yun Si impersonates her slain twin sister to exact revenge on Prince Huo Linye, pairing with Prince Huo Shenzhi.
tvmaze:95314.title: Destined To Be Phoenix

tvmaze:95316.overview: A bachelor struggling to find a bride because of his looks moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start, only to discover that his potential match is his colleague at work.
tvmaze:95316.title: Least Eligible Bachelor

tvmaze:95317.overview: Six-time NBA All-Star and 'NBA on Prime' analyst Blake Griffin hosts The Stepback — a new original series blending late-night comedy with real sports commentary. Every week, Blake breaks down the biggest topics in sports for a live studio audience — from the economics of sports betting and hot-take culture to officiating controversies, athlete empowerment, and the internet's favorite viral moments. Drawing on his lens as a veteran player, sports dad, and lifelong fan, Blake goes beyond game-to-game analysis to cover the cultural forces shaping modern fandom — built for an audience that lives and breathes sports as a lifestyle.
tvmaze:95317.title: The Stepback with Blake Griffin

tvmaze:95331.overview: A bizarre lightning strike causes the souls of Xiao Qingwan, the daughter of a noble family, and Li Mufan, the leader of Qingfeng Village, to be swapped. The two are forced to survive in each other's worlds, and they not only get involved in the grudges of the martial arts world, but also in the conflicts of the imperial court. They rediscover themselves in each other's identities and find their own path to change amidst the misalignment.
tvmaze:95331.title: Reborn in the Abyss

tvmaze:95333.overview: Life-changing strokes turn three young lives upside down. Fighting to reclaim their future, a dancer, a social butterfly and a man in love learn that surviving a stroke is just the beginning.
tvmaze:95333.title: Trauma: My Broken Brain

tvmaze:95334.overview: Get ready, Australia! The world's most famous jungle has a new home on Seven in 2027.
tvmaze:95334.title: I'm a Celebrity… Get Me Out of Here!

tvmaze:95335.overview: Small cameras. Big consequences. From reckless driving to calculated scams, ordinary road users record the evidence that helps police and investigators deliver justice.
tvmaze:95335.title: Dashcam Justice

tvmaze:95337.overview: Bradley Walsh is heading Out of This World in a series exploring some of the greatest mysteries on – and beyond – our planet.With his trademark humour, curiosity and willingness to ask the questions the rest of us are thinking, Bradley travels across Britain, Europe and America in search of answers to one enormous question: are we really alone? From UFOs and USOs to Atlantis, Stonehenge and crop circles, Bradley approaches the unexplained with an open mind, a healthy dose of scepticism and plenty of laughs.
tvmaze:95337.title: Bradley Walsh: Out Of This World

tvmaze:95338.overview: A look at the daily challenges of the hard-working men and women in charge of the operations at some of the busiest harbours in Spain.
tvmaze:95338.title: Port Control: Spain

tvmaze:95363.overview: War, polarization, and unpredictable world leaders – Annika travels with NRK's correspondents to the heart of the crises to gain a better understanding of what is unfolding.
tvmaze:95363.title: Urix x Annika

tvmaze:95365.overview: Eighteen years of abuse and isolation have transformed Wen Ning into a black swan, docile only on the surface. Faced with complex family feuds, she consciously enters the game. Appearing to be submissive and naive, she secretly and coolly leads her own party, gradually rising to the top thanks to her intelligence and beauty. She tears off Wen Hua's mask, exposes her father's true face, which he had hidden for many years, and completely subjugates both the Wen family and his persecutors. Only Jiang Ne was able to discern the dark and complex nature behind her meek exterior, willingly sharing this dance in the shadows with her. Ultimately, Wen Ning breaks free from the shackles of fate, finding her own happiness and a new life.
tvmaze:95365.title: Gentle Taming

tvmaze:95366.overview: Have you ever looked around yourself and asked the question, might the people we know best not be as we imagined?
tvmaze:95366.title: Vamp Eternal Destiny

tvmaze:95368.overview: The most dysfunctional reality-show family is back in Fregene, wilder than ever and ready to take the madness to the next level yet again!
tvmaze:95368.title: Italia Shore

tvmaze:95370.overview: A group of highly attractive singles gathers for a vacation filled with sun, sea, and spicy adventures. But the past is lurking in the form of their EXES ready to crash the party! The sexy contestants are left waiting with bated breath to see if a former flame will show up and throw their single-life plans into total chaos.
tvmaze:95370.title: Ex on the Beach Italia

tvmaze:95371.overview: Chat, a product developer who lives life freely and embraces one-night stands, unexpectedly comes face-to-face with Seung U, his new manager and the man he spent the night with. What was supposed to be a one-night affair becomes the beginning of a rivalry filled with misunderstandings and feelings neither of them can deny. Because sometimes... love is just like product development, it takes countless trials and experiments to finally achieve the best result.
tvmaze:95371.title: The Last Lock of Love

tvmaze:95372.overview: Naturewatch is a weekly celebration of British wildlife.Bringing together the stories that make us curious, the behaviours that make us wonder and the unexpected discoveries about the wildlife we think we know. It's a lively, entertaining deep dive into the natural world on our doorstep.Broadcasting weekly from a studio pod nestled in the British countryside near Bristol, Chris Packham will be joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin – three curious minds, a wealth of expertise and one shared obsession with the natural world.
tvmaze:95372.title: Naturewatch

tvmaze:9539.overview: NBC Nightly News is the most-watched evening newscast in America, providing the very latest on the day's top stories and going beyond the headlines to add context and analysis to the most pressing issues of our time, both at home and abroad. We go to the heart of breaking news stories, introduce you to everyday people caught up in extraordinary events, offer in-depth reporting on health and medicine, cover international news as it unfolds and we profile those who inspire us to do better in our popular Making A Difference reports. The award-winning broadcast carries a legacy that spans more than six decades, beginning in 1948 - when NBC started broadcasting television's first-ever regularly scheduled network evening newscast.
tvmaze:9539.title: NBC Nightly News

tvmaze:95392.overview: This gripping drama series tells the tragic story of Melania Rea, whose case reveals a toxic marriage marked by lies and manipulation.
tvmaze:95392.title: Melania Rea

tvmaze:95393.overview: The series follows internet sensation John "Big John" Fisher and his wife Charlotte, the heart and backbone of the Fisher household, alongside their children, including rising boxing star Johnny "The Romford Bull", city boy William, and their youngest and only daughter, Hetty. Not forgetting 'Fat Nan' and 'Skinny Nan.' Across six episodes, Big John's Bosh! Family throws open the doors to the wonderfully chaotic world of Big John and the Fisher clan. Juggling viral fame, family milestones, and fresh adventures, life for the family is anything but ordinary. With big characters, bigger laughs and plenty of surprises along the way including appearances from celebrity friends Joe Marler, Eddie Hearn, Dana White and Joey Essex, the series offers an unfiltered glimpse into the chaos, comedy and heart that have turned Big John and the Fishers into an international phenomenon.
tvmaze:95393.title: Big John's Bosh! Family

tvmaze:95395.overview: Five celebrities race in moving podiums across a star-spangled-themed studio to try to win £10,000 for their chosen charity.
tvmaze:95395.title: The Famous Finish Line

tvmaze:95396.overview: A warm cultural heritage project that brings centuries-old folktales of Turkish oral culture together with child co-hosts' reenactments and traditional storytelling, instilling empathy, sharing, and imagination in new generations.
tvmaze:95396.title: Gökten Üç Elma Düştü

tvmaze:95397.overview: Stacey Dooley, heads into the wilderness to explore Australia's most remote communities: from an isolated cattle station, to deep within the rainforest, to a very special island.
tvmaze:95397.title: Stacey Dooley's Australia: Off the Beaten Track

tvmaze:95398.overview: Jordan & Sophie: A TOWIE Baby trades glitz for baby bottles, following TOWIE and Geordie Shore favourites Jordan Brook and Sophie Kasaei as they step into an exciting new chapter after welcoming their miracle baby boy, Brody.Having faced years of fertility struggles and the quiet grief of a uncertain future, the couple are now living the life they once only dreamed of. However, the final stages of Sophie's pregnancy weren't without their challenges, as Jordan battled an illness that added unexpected pressure and uncertainty to an already emotional time for the couple.Follow their journey as they navigate the whirlwind of newborn parenthood, introduce Brody to their loved ones, and take a crash course in life as a family.
tvmaze:95398.title: Jordan & Sophie: A TOWIE Baby

tvmaze:95399.overview: Cameras follow TOWIE royalty Amy Childs and her husband Billy Delbosq as they finally get their happy ending: a Spanish wedding years in the making, and a year overdue.
tvmaze:95399.title: Amy Childs: A TOWIE Wedding

tvmaze:95400.overview: A man takes a night-shift job at a mysterious convenience store, where employees must follow a strict set of strange rules. Breaking these rules can unleash terrifying supernatural events, forcing him to confront the dark secrets surrounding the store.
tvmaze:95400.title: The Rules

tvmaze:95403.overview: A look at disputes between neighbours in the UK, with exclusive access to the battles raging behind Britain's front doors.
tvmaze:95403.title: At War with Next Door

tvmaze:95404.overview: Michael Strahan has lived an extraordinary life: Hall of Fame football player, beloved TV host and journalist, prolific entrepreneur, and cultural icon. Now, in a new three-part series, co-produced by Strahan and Constance Schwartz-Morini's SMAC Productions, he embarks on a personal journey across the worlds of fashion, television and music to turn the lens on the icons who have inspired him and transformed American culture. Speaking with acclaimed actors, musicians, moguls and more, he takes us into the worlds of legendary trailblazers who broke new ground and became iconic.
tvmaze:95404.title: Michael Strahan's Iconic

tvmaze:95406.overview: While continuing to cover dark and provocative cases of women who kill and featuring first-hand accounts from those close to the cases, Deadly Women 2.0 will delve deeper into the psychology behind the crimes – unpacking the obsession, betrayal, relationship dynamics, and other triggers that factor into these female perpetrators' decision to carry out deadly acts. Over the course of the season, Dr. Michelle Ward and Dr. Rachel Toles will use their extensive backgrounds in criminal and forensic psychology to explore a variety of cases from custody battles and work rivalries that escalate to violence to romantic disputes and forbidden love that turns violent.
tvmaze:95406.title: Deadly Women 2.0

tvmaze:95407.overview: Christmas is approaching in Brårud, and Jon wants to highlight the authentic, traditional rural Christmas. But since Jon is no expert on the subject, he invites some of his good neighbors and friends to join him in creating a unique Christmas special from Brårud. Together, they host a pre-Christmas celebration at Villa Breen, and we get to follow along with the preparations. Safety boots and tractors are swapped for garlands and *sylte* (traditional pressed pork terrine). The focus shifts from sowing depth and grain moisture to an equally intense, "nerdy" deep dive into local traditions, the perfect conditions for making *lefse*, and the crafting of traditional Christmas baskets. Is Hillevi better at a thorough deep-clean than Jon? How does Ellen fare as a TV chef? Is it Lars or Karl who truly shines at the Christmas craft workshop? And, perhaps most importantly: how well do they actually know their Christmas carols? It's time to ring in the Brårud Christmas!
tvmaze:95407.title: Jul på Brårud

tvmaze:95408.overview: Neo-Nazis invade the summer camp of a group of Viking enthusiasts. Now they are wondering how to deal with them, with kind words and thoughts, or with swords?
tvmaze:95408.title: Vikinger vs. nazister

tvmaze:95409.overview: A flavorful stop that brings to the screen the history and refined preparation techniques of time-honored beverages, from traditional palace sherbets and modern coffee recipes to healing winter teas and salep culture.
tvmaze:95409.title: Ne İçersiniz?

tvmaze:95410.overview: Known for his viral stunts, including creating London's #1-rated fake restaurant, Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world's biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories. Subversive, funny, and irreverent, Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow proves that hacking the system might be the best path toward a brighter future.
tvmaze:95410.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow

tvmaze:95412.overview: Livestreamer Jiang Liaoliao becomes entangled in boss Ji Mingshuo's family marriage dispute. They stage a fake courtship to fend off his relatives' schemes, but the performance gradually becomes a real romance.
tvmaze:95412.title: Women Love Wealth

tvmaze:95413.overview: Song Zhiyi and Huo Yanli were married due to an arrangement made by their elders, with a promise to divorce after five years. She went to a distant place to dedicate herself silently, while he watched coldly and mocked her. Despite her lack of ambition and ambition, she won the respect of the entire Huo family with her professionalism and magnanimity, and also moved Huo Yanli from indifference to affection. When the five-year period ended, she resolutely left, and he abandoned everything to chase after her to the ends of the earth, saying, "You have your mountains and seas to reach, but the mountains and seas I want to reach are you."
tvmaze:95413.title: Yan Zhi Shanhe Yi

tvmaze:95414.overview: Seven years after leaving her first love, an award-winning architect enters a business marriage, only to discover the groom is the man she once left behind, who has quietly planned their reunion
tvmaze:95414.title: Ling Lan Ding Lü

tvmaze:95415.overview: Ning Xiaonuan, a freshman at Chulalongkorn University, was attacked at her sister's wedding and became embroiled in an incident involving Di Xiao, a mercenary leader. Di Xiao mistakenly believes Ning Xiaonuan's father is the criminal he's investigating and approaches her for help, simultaneously developing a strong attraction and possessiveness toward her. Ning Xiaonuan is forced to collaborate with Di Xiao to save her father, and in the process, she learns of Di Xiao's previously unknown troubled past. Ultimately, the misunderstanding is resolved, the real culprit is caught, and they are reunited.
tvmaze:95415.title: Untamed Wildcat

tvmaze:95416.overview: During his student years, Su Tang saved Lu Huaisheng, and from then on, her long, secret love began. Upon meeting again, Su Tang and Lu Huaisheng accidentally spent the night together, Su Tang became pregnant, they married, and began their journey from a marriage of convenience to true love. Under Lu Huaisheng's powerful and profound protection, the resilient and courageous Su Tang, like a delicate flower, continually grew and transformed!
tvmaze:95416.title: After Years of Being a Chush

tvmaze:95417.overview: By a strange coincidence, Yan Cheng and Ling Yan's long-standing rivalry ends at the Civil Affairs Bureau. Finding understanding in marriage will be extremely difficult. Or maybe not so difficult… Perhaps, after just a few dozen comical situations and moments of intimacy, the eternal rivals will turn into eternal lovers?
tvmaze:95417.title: Ming Zhong Zhu Ding Dui Ni

tvmaze:95418.overview: Not a trace of her former luxury remains: her father is dead, the company is destroyed, and the traitor is at large. The only chance to reclaim the family legacy is to trust a cynical investor and start from scratch. Will the pampered heiress prove to the world that she was written off prematurely, or will cold calculation destroy her last hope?
tvmaze:95418.title: Rising With the Wind

tvmaze:95419.overview: Ruan Ting Xia, adopted daughter of the Zhou family, witnesses her fiancé Zhou Yan Chen's engagement to someone else. Heartbroken, she gets drunk and hastily marries Song Ji Lin, a rising star in the business world. Initially, it was a marriage of convenience, and Song Ji Lin spoiled her with incomparable tenderness.
tvmaze:95419.title: Contract to the Heart

tvmaze:95420.overview: Wen Yi Ning and Gu Xi Zhou have been together for 5 years. When she was about to propose to Gu Xi Zhou, she heard that he only treated her as a toy and that he really liked someone else. The heartbroken Wen Yi Ning chose to accept Pei Yu Zhi's proposal and left Gu Xi Zhou.
tvmaze:95420.title: Darling, I'm Getting Married

tvmaze:95421.overview: Orphaned young, Na Dan Bi is raised under the iron rule of her strict uncle, who molds her life to his desires. Outwardly obedient but fiercely independent inside, she spends a night with Moon Seo Won at her cousin's wedding, hoping his influence can free her from her uncle's control. But when he unexpectedly falls for her, they are both drawn into a perilous web of love, power, and secrets.
tvmaze:95421.title: She Was Never a Good Girl

tvmaze:95422.overview: Rong Zhi Yan, a wealthy architect heiress, agrees to a marriage of convenience and on her wedding day learns that her fiancé and the father of her child is Yi Chen Ze, whom she abandoned seven years earlier. He is the illegitimate eldest son of the He family, who returned to the family through this union. He promises revenge, but his feelings for Rong Zhi Yan remain. She resists this feigned revenge, hesitates, but her heart is no longer deceived.
tvmaze:95422.title: The Lily of the Valley Law: Growing Closer the More We Love

tvmaze:95423.overview: Smart, humorous and tenacious, 25-year-old Qiu Yu is adept at working and is the right-hand secretary of CEO Ji Xiang Dong. Faced with the constant challenges of old love and family interference, Ji Xiang Dong's feelings beneath his cold exterior gradually emerge. Secretary Qiu bravely chooses her own happiness in the whirlpool of work and love.
tvmaze:95423.title: Secretary Qiu's Marriage

tvmaze:95424.overview: An Zhisu was framed for murder and imprisoned in a mental hospital for five years. During those five years, An Zhisu played the role of a well-behaved girl. After her release, she married Ye Lancheng, the president of the Shengshi Consortium. The two went from strangers to acquaintances, and eventually fell in love, with Ye Lancheng always protecting her. Ultimately, with Ye Lancheng's help, An Zhisu cleared her name and reclaimed everything
tvmaze:95424.title: Deeply Pampered Marriage: Accidentally Provoking A Billionaire Husband

tvmaze:95425.overview: "Gu Chenzhou, you always bleed for me. In this life, will you shed tears for me?" She thought that as her bodyguard, he was willing to die for her, but unwilling to love her. Little did she know, he was feeding a tiger with his own body, calculating everything, except for his own heart. On the two sides of a sharp blade, they saw threads of love piercing through the gaps between black and white.
tvmaze:95425.title: Kill My Sins

tvmaze:95426.overview: Quan Wei was born with a mysterious condition that causes her to age in reverse, growing younger as the years pass. At thirty-five, she meets nineteen-year-old Gu Yao, but their attraction frightens her because their lives are moving in opposite directions. Eight years later, they meet again when both appear twenty-seven, only for fate to repeatedly separate and reunite them. Eventually Quan Wei becomes a nineteen-year-old girl while Gu Yao reaches thirty, forcing her to reveal the extraordinary truth she has been hiding and leaving them to decide whether their love can survive time itself.
tvmaze:95426.title: Tomorrow Love Letter

tvmaze:95427.overview: Clarkson's Farm breakout star Kaleb Cooper is going solo in a brand-new series—swapping Chipping Norton for the Australian outback.Kaleb Off The Farm follows the farming contractor on his first-ever solo trip abroad, and his first time on a plane, as he heads Down Under with dreams of striking it rich in Australian farming. But first he'll need to conquer wheat fields the size of small countries, round up wild cattle on horseback, and learn the hard way that crocodiles aren't just oversized farm dogs.
tvmaze:95427.title: Kaleb Off The Farm

tvmaze:95428.overview: The disgraced Xunjia is shown the door, and her birth parents, having already received money for her, also refuse to take her in. Just when she feels there's nowhere left to return to, the silent Li Feng extends his hand and utters a few words: "I'll give you a home."
tvmaze:95428.title: Chao Qi Xing De Tongxing

tvmaze:95429.overview: Su Ziyue, the second young lady of the Su family, suffers long-term rumors and cold treatment due to her scheming cousin. After making a bet with her grandfather to regain her father's shares, she has no choice but to find someone for a flash marriage. She casually pulls Qin Muchen, a man involved in a car accident with her, thinking she married a poor nobody. Surprisingly, her husband turns out to be the behind-the-scenes boss of the top conglomerate Xingyao Group! After marriage, Muchen fiercely protects her, dealing with her scumbag ex-boyfriend, punishing her cousin, and helping her secure a multi-million-dollar deal to fully clear her name. The two fall in love after marriage, overflowing with romance!
tvmaze:95429.title: Shan Hun Hou Wo Zai Fu Jia Hun Shui Mo Yu

tvmaze:95430.overview: On the eve of her wedding, supermodel Rong Mei spends one night with a rugged mechanic. A public scandal follows. Then she learns the 'mechanic' is far more powerful than he appeared.
tvmaze:95430.title: Obsessed with Her

tvmaze:95431.overview: Jiang Wan Zhi and Ximen Li Chen, the prince of a scientific research family, were having an underground love affair. They dated for three months in college and then broke up for three years. Jiang Wan Zhi was forced to marry the playboy of the Fu family. She drove her fiancé and lover to the hotel on a rainy night, but she didn't expect that the noble man sitting in the luxury car that was hit by the car accident was actually her ex-boyfriend who had been dumped.
tvmaze:95431.title: Utterly Submit

tvmaze:95432.overview: Shen Ci Yu, a good-for-nothing daughter, was lying down at home and was kicked out by her parents, who asked her to be self-reliant. Shen Ci Yu learned that her best friend's uncle was recruiting a wife with a high salary, so she immediately went for an interview and finally got a marriage certificate under the temptation of a high salary. She thought she could live a carefree life, but she didn't expect that the curtain of a secret love would slowly be unveiled.
tvmaze:95432.title: Mr. Bo, Madame Sold You for Money

tvmaze:95433.overview: In a cooling marriage, Shi Yue meets her husband's friend Qin Zhao, who is drawn to the bold woman beneath her dutiful-wife facade. Their growing connection unsettles the stable life she wanted.
tvmaze:95433.title: Yue Ye Yue Shu

tvmaze:95434.overview: Wen Ying and Jiang Chen Ye married through a family alliance agreement. What began as a mechanical, routine way of getting along gradually shifted into a sweet, irresistible pull of affection. The icy, aloof husband is slowly melted by his soft and adorable wife, leading to a mutually devoted, healing romance.
tvmaze:95434.title: Ban Shu Lao Gong

tvmaze:95435.overview: In her previous life, Shi Xing followed her family's arrangement and got engaged to He Sheng, only to suffer his betrayal and cruelty, ending in mutual destruction with Qi Chen Yan. After being reborn, Shi Xing bravely pursues Qi Chen Yan, and the two begin a sweet romance. The story unfolds around their emotional journey, gradually revealing the truth of their past lives, and ultimately, the two attain a happy ending together.
tvmaze:95435.title: Reborn in Your Embrace
